jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We Are Bring IT! 🚀

We are a young, dynamic, and fast-growing professional services company bringing digital transformation to our clients around the world. From launching products to market to driving productivity with the right technology and processes, the work we do is improving the way people work. To achieve this, we are building a global and diverse team capable of tackling some of today’s most important challenges. We call this unique approach “360 Success.”

We are recognized as one of the fastest-growing and most successful companies in the INC5000 ranking in the U.S. 🇺🇸, and we are opening new offices around the world to continue growing, exploring, and diversifying. With more than 10 recognitions from our partners, we continue to lead in our markets. 🏆

About The Role

As a Project Manager, you lead end-to-end delivery of standard implementations, ensuring projects are executed on time, within scope, and on budget. You manage planning, risks, and stakeholder communication while coordinating a small team of consultants. You act as the central point of accountability, driving project health, facilitating decisions, and ensuring adherence to delivery methodology and quality standards.

What You'll Do

Lead end-to-end delivery of standard implementations, keeping projects on time, in scope, and on budget.
Run structured project cadences — status updates, risk reviews, and planning — and keep the plan current.
Coordinate a small team of consultants while acting as the central point of accountability for the project.
Anticipate and mitigate risks before they escalate, rather than just logging them.
Communicate project status clearly to different audiences, including trade-offs and impacts, not just updates.

Role Profile

Required

Education / Degree Requirement: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or related field.
Years of Experience: 1 to 2 years of project management experience in ERP, software implementation, or technology consulting environments.
Language Requirements: Professional proficiency in English and Spanish, both written and verbal. Portuguese language skills may be required depending on the location and business needs.

Preferred

Certifications: NetSuite SuiteFoundation or PMP certification is required. CAPM, PRINCE2, PSM, CSM, SAFe, NetSuite Certified Administrator, and NetSuite ERP Consultant certifications are considered strong assets.

Growing With Us

Growth from Project Manager isn't limited to one path. Most Project Managers move into the Senior Project Manager role next, but a move into the Implementations Consultant or Managed Services Business System Consultant track is equally documented.

Our Values

At Bring IT, we put people first, break new ground, and win through excellence — all while finding strength in the diversity of our global team. We work hard, play hard, and show up for each other, because when we take care of our people, everything else follows.

What Makes Us Stand Out?

The Bring IT team has over 150 people spread across many countries around the world. We understand that great technology begins with great talent and diversity of thought. Our business is being built on friendship, teamwork and a passion for what we do. This is shaping our culture every day and we're looking for great talent that want to make an impact in the world.

Community Impact

We connect our objectives to the United Nations sustainable goals, especially in clean energy, health & wellbeing and infrastructure. Moving forward we will start supporting special sustainability programs and perhaps you want to be part of that.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging

Bring It is committed to respecting and promoting equal treatment without discrimination based on sex, ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation or identity, gender expression, socioeconomic status, or any other legally protected characteristic. It also ensures equal opportunities in access to employment and fosters an organizational culture of respect, diversity, and inclusion at all levels.

Ready to join Bring IT?

Apply now and help shape the future of digital transformation. 🚀

jobs.description:
Company Description

At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.

Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking #1 for PACS Europe UK/Ireland in the 2026 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non-US) report.

Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager III to lead successful delivery of medium-to-large-scale healthcare IT implementations for radiology and cardiology imaging solutions. This role requires strong project management expertise combined with the ability to navigate complex customer environments, coordinate cross-functional teams, and ensure on-time, on-budget project completion. The ideal candidate brings proven experience managing multiple concurrent implementations, mentoring junior team members, and building trusted advisor relationships with healthcare provider clients. This position plays a critical role in ensuring customers realize the full value of Intelerad's medical imaging platforms throughout their implementation journey.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project planning, execution, and delivery for medium to large-scale healthcare IT implementations, managing project scope, timeline, budget, and resource allocation to ensure successful outcomes that meet customer requirements and business objectives.
Serve as primary customer contact and trusted advisor throughout project lifecycle, proactively identifying and resolving issues, managing escalations cross-functionally, and maintaining transparent communication with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.
Coordinate Professional Services resources across implementation teams, create and maintain comprehensive project documentation including plans, status reports, and meeting minutes, and ensure all deliverables meet quality standards and established timelines.
Mentor Project Manager I and II team members, providing guidance on best practices, escalation management, and customer relationship development to build team capability and ensure consistent delivery excellence across the PMO organization.
Lead internal transformation and standardization initiatives under PMO leadership direction, contributing to continuous improvement programs that enhance delivery methodology, tools, and team performance across Professional Services.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
5+ years of experience in project management roles, with demonstrated success leading medium to largescale technology implementations
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritize competing demands, and deliver results within timeline and budget constraints

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

Experience managing healthcare IT projects or working in healthcare provider environments strongly preferred
Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt certification
Experience with radiology or cardiology healthcare IT solutions such as PACS, RIS, or enterprise imaging platforms
Experience managing projects in North American healthcare setting
Skills in cloud architecture and networking a major advantage, AWS preferred
CAPM or PMP certification

Travel Requirements

This position requires up to 25% travel, primarily throughout North America

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Senior
jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA's Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation's skies safe and connected.

We're looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world's most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won't just support the mission - you'll define it.

Project Manager - Surveillance & Radar Systems

Shape the Future of Air Traffic Management with Peraton

Join a team dedicated to protecting the safety, efficiency, and integrity of U.S. air travel
. At Peraton, we partner with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to support and modernize the systems that keep the National Airspace System (NAS) operating safely and efficiently.

Peraton is seeking dynamic, technically focused Project Managers
to join our team of talented and diverse professionals. In this role, you will provide leadership across critical Surveillance and Radar Systems
initiatives, guiding planning, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and execution to ensure program objectives are achieved.

Whether you are leading multidisciplinary engineering teams, coordinating safety and validation activities, or supporting major FAA modernization initiatives, your work will have a direct impact on the systems relied upon by millions of passengers, aviation professionals, and communities every day
.

This is an opportunity to bring your project leadership expertise to a mission where the work you do truly matters.

Work Location

Preferred location: Herndon, VA
Work arrangement: Primarily on-site; remote work options may be considered based on candidate qualifications and program requirements.

In This Role, You Will

Lead the planning and execution of multidisciplinary workstreams supporting Surveillance and Radar Systems and related engineering activities.
Establish priorities, coordinate resources, and ensure work remains aligned with program objectives, schedules, and stakeholder expectations.
Lead and motivate high-performing teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and a culture focused on mission success.
Engage with stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations, communicate priorities, and provide clear and timely program updates.
Monitor program performance, schedules, and delivery metrics to identify risks, remove roadblocks, and drive continuous improvement.
Collaborate with product owners, system vendors, developers, FAA facilities, engineering teams, and leadership to maintain alignment and deliver mission value.
Develop and maintain roadmaps, status reports, action items, and program documentation to provide visibility and support informed decision-making.
Identify emerging challenges and opportunities, develop mitigation strategies, and help teams navigate complex technical and organizational issues.
Support change management and communications to facilitate the successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and tools.
Promote effective cross-functional collaboration while ensuring deliverables meet program, technical, quality, and mission requirements.

Why This Role Matters

The National Airspace System is one of the world's most sophisticated and mission-critical infrastructures
, and the systems supporting it must perform reliably every day.

As a Project Manager supporting Surveillance and Radar Systems, you will help lead the people, processes, and technology behind critical aviation capabilities. Your leadership will help teams respond to evolving requirements, manage complex initiatives, reduce risk, and deliver solutions that strengthen the safety, efficiency, and readiness of the nation's airspace.

At Peraton, you won't just manage projects-you'll help shape the future of air traffic management.

Qualifications

Position Requirements:

U.S. Citizenship required.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's degree with 8 years of experience, Master's with 6 years, Associate's with 10 years, or HS diploma/equivalent with 12 years of relevant experience.
Proven project leadership experience supporting Surveillance and/or Radar Systems, including surface surveillance, sensor data feeds, multi-sensor fusion, primary/secondary radar, SSR, ASR, or similar systems.
FAA Technical Operations (TechOps) experience required, with demonstrated experience maintaining and supporting mission-critical NAS systems.
Direct experience with FAA Technical Services Operations Group (TSOG) or as an Airway Transportation Systems Specialist (ATSS) supporting NAS infrastructure.
Hands-on technical experience with airport surface surveillance/radar systems, including architecture, hardware, software, system interfaces, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
Experience coordinating site and facility activities, including installation, modification, system acceptance, and field deployment.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to drive alignment, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in dynamic, mission-critical environments.

Preferred Qualifications

FAA TechOps, TSOG, or ATSS experience, with SMR/ASDE experience highly desirable.
Experience supporting FAA NextGen, NAS modernization, or federal aviation programs.
Experience managing federal modernization programs or large-scale enterprise initiatives.
Familiarity with FAA standards, facility directives, and compliance requirements.
Knowledge of risk management, budgeting, and program governance.

Details

Target Salary Range: $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. jobs.title: Program Manager, Risk Operations GTM Enablement
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk PMO team protects Stripe’s revenue and drives cross-functional strategy for company-level and org-level priorities. As Stripe operates across an increasingly complex and fast-moving global regulatory environment, one of our most important functions is ensuring that our largest, most strategic users can grow with us—compliantly, confidently, and at speed.

We sit at the intersection of Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and GTM—serving as the bridge between teams coordinating massive programs with global, wide-reaching impact. We build durable systems that enable strong collaboration across functions and seamless experiences for our users.

If you're energized by high-stakes, ambiguous problems and thrive on building programs from scratch in environments where the rules are still being written—we want to hear from you.

What you’ll do

You will define, own, and execute program strategies for large-scale regulatory initiatives, operating with significant autonomy across a portfolio of global projects.

This is a highly visible, senior individual contributor (IC) role. While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end, from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management
Drive step-change improvements in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics
Bridge compliance and commercial strategy by partnering with GTM and account leadership to turn complex regulatory requirements into a competitive advantage that builds deep user trust
Build and run operating models across diverse cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance), keeping highly distributed workstreams aligned and accountable
Serve as a trusted advisor by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations
Translate user friction into program evolution by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements
Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure
Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first

Who you are

You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks.

You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Hands-on execution track record: Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing complex, multi-stakeholder project plans and deliverables from inception to completion
Exceptional communication & storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to distill highly complex, technical, or regulatory topics into clear, succinct, and persuasive narratives to external and senior audiences
Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks
Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments
Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales
Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

Job Summary

11400Inc.
is seeking a Project Manager with experience in commercial construction to join our North Carolina operations team. We are construction professionals specializing in commercial foodservice equipment and installation projects.

This position may be office-based in the Charlotte, NC area or remote within our NC office territory
. For remote candidates, South Carolina and Georgia are preferred locations, with the greater Atlanta area being of particular interest
as we continue to support and expand our project coverage throughout the Southeast. Remote candidates must reside within reasonable travel distance of their assigned project territory.

Project Managers are responsible for managing, controlling, tracking, and coordinating all aspects of commercial kitchen projects from submittals through procurement, installation, and project closeout.

www.11400inc.com

Our Project Managers oversee multiple active projects simultaneously throughout our territory, including North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, West Virginia, Tennessee, and Georgia
. Regular project site travel is an important part of the position.

We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including 401(k), paid vacation, and wellness programs. Salary is based on experience.

Responsibilities

Successfully manage multiple commercial construction projects simultaneously while meeting project deadlines and commitments.
Maintain timely and effective communication with general contractors, design teams, vendors, subcontractors, and internal project team members.
Organize, review, and manage construction documents, equipment submittals, shop drawings, and project correspondence.
Track project schedules, procurement requirements, change orders, RFIs, ASIs, and other project-related documentation.
Review project requirements and proactively identify coordination issues before they impact fabrication, delivery, or installation.
Visit project sites and attend construction meetings as necessary.
Oversee equipment procurement, fabrication, and delivery schedules.
Coordinate equipment installation with general contractors, subcontractors, and associated trades.
Assist with field coordination, installation readiness, punch list completion, and project closeout.
Take ownership of assigned projects and proactively communicate issues, risks, and required decisions.
Look for opportunities to improve efficiency, organization, and accuracy throughout the project lifecycle.

Physical Requirements

Work is performed while sitting/standing and interfacing with a personal computer.
Requires the ability to communicate effectively using speech, vision, and hearing.
Requires the regular use of hands for simple grasping and fine manipulations.
Requires occasional bending, squatting, crawling, climbing, and reaching.
Requires the ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull medium weights, up to 50lbs.

Remote Work Qualifications

Access to a reliable and secure high-speed internet connection. Cable or fiber internet connections (at least 75mbps download/10mbps upload) are preferred, as satellite connections often cannot support the technologies used to perform day-to-day tasks.
Access to a home router and modem.
A dedicated home office space that is noise- and distraction-free. The space should have strong wireless connection or a wired Ethernet connection (wired connection is preferred, if possible).
A valid, physical address (apartment, suite, etc.). PO Boxes are not supported, as a physical address is required for you to receive your computer equipment.

Legal residents of one of the following states: (CT, DE, FL, GA, MD, NC, PA, SC, VA, or WV). H-1B Visa Sponsorship Not Available, W2 only.

Experience

Analytical and detail oriented, with the ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced team environment.
Self motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Willing and able to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.
Demonstrates leadership characteristics and sound decision making skills.
Possesses strong problem solving skills and natural mechanical aptitude.
Excellent organizational and written/verbal communication skills.
Comfortable reading and interpreting construction drawings, specifications, and project documents.

This role does not require a degree. We value relevant skills and experience and alignment with our core values above all else.

Prior experience in commercial construction, architecture, engineering, or design is preferred.

jobs.title: Project Manager & Test Lead (Hybrid Agile / Waterfall)
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Job Description

Context & Mission Background

A leading global manufacturing and life sciences organization is executing a worldwide digital transformation program to replace legacy paper and decentralized Permit-to-Work (PTW) workflows with a unified, cloud-based Enterprise Electronic Permit-to-Work (E-PTW) SaaS solution.

The program encompasses a global rollout across dozens of production, R&D, and tertiary facilities, onboarding 20,000+ internal personnel and contractor partners. The platform integrates with enterprise ERP/CMMS and cloud data lake architectures.

Delivery Governance:
Hybrid Model

Waterfall Program Governance: Multi-wave deployment gates, compliance sign-offs, centralized testing gates, and transition to steady-state Run/Support.
Agile Sprints: Iterative core-model build, configuration sprints, interface testing, and continuous feedback loops.

Role Overview

The Project Manager & Test Lead will orchestrate the global multi-wave deployment while establishing, structuring, and leading the Centralized Testing & Quality Assurance Workstream (Core Model validation, System Integration Testing / SIT, and centralized User Acceptance Testing / UAT).

Key Responsibilities

Hybrid Program & Multi-Wave Governance
Lead global program execution across all deployment phases (Core Build, Pilot Phase, Multi-Wave Rollouts, and Handover to Run/AIMS).
Maintain the master project schedule, milestones, dependencies, budget envelope, and RAID log.
Facilitate Agile configuration ceremonies while enforcing Waterfall stage gates (Core Model Sign-Off, Centralized UAT Go/No-Go, Site Deployment Readiness, Hypercare Exit).
Align technical delivery milestones with the Change Management team’s ADKAR gate reviews.
Centralized Test Strategy & Testing Team Leadership
Define, govern, and execute the Centralized Test Strategy covering Unit, SIT, Core Model UAT, Non-Regression, and Interface/Data Testing.
Lead and coordinate the centralized test team, managing technical testers, business representatives, and vendor test engineers.
Define formal Entry/Exit criteria for Centralized UAT and manage defect triage workflows and SLA tracking in Jira.
Oversee integration and data-flow testing between the SaaS solution, enterprise ERP/CMMS systems, and enterprise data platforms.
Produce formal test summary reports and quality metrics for executive Steering Committees and formal deployment stage gates.
Vendor & Partner Delivery Management
Manage deliverables, technical backlogs, and commitments with the external SaaS provider and systems integrators.
Track enterprise dependencies including IAM/Single Sign-On and external contractor access frameworks.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Experience: 7+ years in Project Management within global manufacturing, chemical, pharmaceutical, or regulated industrial environments.
Methodology: Proven track record in Hybrid delivery (PMP / PRINCE2 combined with Agile / Scrum / SAFe).
Testing Leadership: 4+ years leading testing teams and managing structured test lifecycles (ISTQB certification or equivalent practical expertise).
Tooling: Advanced proficiency in Jira, Confluence, test management and familiarity with enterprise ERP/CMMS ecosystems.

Languages:
at least upper-intermediate English (mandatory); French or additional European languages will be a big plus

What You Will Love About Working Here

We care about all our employees and want them to feel as comfortable as possible. That's why we offer them health insurance from the first days, regardless of the probationary period.
The gift from the company - Christmas holidays from 25 December to 31 December.
Сooperation with Superhumans center and Veteran HUB. Capgemini Engineering has supported the launch of psychological rehabilitation department of Superhumans. Our team also donated over UAH 500 000 prosthetics for three Ukrainian defenders. Currently, we support psychological counseling provided by the Veteran Hub, and we have implemented an internal policy making the company friendly to military and veterans with the assistance of the Hub.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Risk Operations GTM Enablement
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk PMO team protects Stripe’s revenue and drives cross-functional strategy for company-level and org-level priorities. As Stripe operates across an increasingly complex and fast-moving global regulatory environment, one of our most important functions is ensuring that our largest, most strategic users can grow with us—compliantly, confidently, and at speed.

We sit at the intersection of Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and GTM—serving as the bridge between teams coordinating massive programs with global, wide-reaching impact. We build durable systems that enable strong collaboration across functions and seamless experiences for our users.

If you're energized by high-stakes, ambiguous problems and thrive on building programs from scratch in environments where the rules are still being written—we want to hear from you.

What you’ll do

You will define, own, and execute program strategies for large-scale regulatory initiatives, operating with significant autonomy across a portfolio of global projects.

This is a highly visible, senior individual contributor (IC) role. While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end, from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management
Drive step-change improvements in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics
Bridge compliance and commercial strategy by partnering with GTM and account leadership to turn complex regulatory requirements into a competitive advantage that builds deep user trust
Build and run operating models across diverse cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance), keeping highly distributed workstreams aligned and accountable
Serve as a trusted advisor by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations
Translate user friction into program evolution by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements
Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure
Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first

Who you are

You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks.

You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Hands-on execution track record: Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing complex, multi-stakeholder project plans and deliverables from inception to completion
Exceptional communication & storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to distill highly complex, technical, or regulatory topics into clear, succinct, and persuasive narratives to external and senior audiences
Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks
Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments
Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales
Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is currently seeking skilled and qualified candidates for a Program Manager
position to provide overall program leadership and serve as the single point of accountability for contractor performance supporting Peraton and the customer. The Program Manager will oversee program execution across all four contract task areas, ensuring performance meets contractual requirements, schedules, quality standards, and customer expectations.

You will lead program planning, governance, stakeholder engagement, Agile execution, transition activities, subcontractor management, and performance reporting. The Program Manager will serve as the primary interface with the Technical Point of Contact (TPOC), Contracting Officer/Contracting Officer's Representative (CO/COR), and Government stakeholders.

The Program Manager will ensure effective coordination across contractor teams and subcontractors, maintain program visibility through management dashboards and reporting, and drive timely resolution of schedule, staffing, cost, performance, and operational issues.

Day to Day Work Responsibilities:

Serve as the single point of accountability to the customer POC for all contractor performance across all four contract task areas.
Schedule, coordinate, and host the Project Kick-Off Meeting, ensuring participation by all required Key Personnel.
Convene and chair monthly Technical Status Meetings with customer and Government stakeholders.
Develop, deliver, and maintain the Monthly Status Report (MSR), including personnel gains and losses, cost by Contract Line Item Number (CLIN), schedule status, program performance, and corrective actions.
Develop, maintain, and continuously update the Project Management Plan (PMP) and Agile Roadmap, incorporating Government feedback and comments.
Provide monthly Agile Roadmap briefings covering 30-, 60-, and 90-day schedules, critical dependencies, milestones, and schedule risks.
Oversee and coordinate all contractor travel authorizations and Trip Report submissions.
Maintain the Management Dashboard with real-time or near-real-time program, personnel, schedule, cost, and performance data.
Lead Transition-In execution and ensure all required transition activities are completed within 90 calendar days of the Project Kick-Off.
Develop and deliver the Transition-Out Plan within six months of performance start and implement the plan no later than six months before contract expiration.
Manage and oversee subcontractor performance, other program teammates.
Monitor program execution across multiple workstreams to ensure contractual requirements, milestones, deliverables, and performance objectives are achieved.
Identify, assess, and communicate program risks, issues, dependencies, and corrective actions to Government and contractor leadership.
Establish and maintain effective program governance, communication, reporting, and escalation processes.
Coordinate cross-functional contractor resources to ensure successful execution of program requirements and delivery commitments.
Apply Agile program management practices to support iterative planning, execution, prioritization, and delivery.
Ensure program documentation, status reporting, schedules, roadmaps, and management artifacts remain accurate, current, and compliant with contractual requirements.
Monitor staffing, personnel changes, cost performance, schedule performance, and other program metrics to identify potential impacts to contract execution.
Drive continuous process improvement across program management, reporting, transition, governance, and stakeholder engagement activities.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
U.S. Citizenship required.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance and a DEA suitability determination.
10+ years of IT program and/or project management experience.
5+ years of experience managing programs of comparable scope and complexity; experience with programs exceeding $100M in annual contract value preferred
PMP Certification
ITIL v4 Foundation or higher certification
SAFe Agilist or SAFe Program Consultant certification
Demonstrated experience managing multiple workstreams, contractor teams, and subcontractors within a complex federal IT environment.
Experience developing and managing Program Management Plans, Agile Roadmaps, schedules, status reports, risk registers, and other program management artifacts.
Experience leading Government-facing meetings, briefings, program reviews, and executive-level communications.
Experience managing program transitions, including Transition-In and Transition-Out activities.
Strong understanding of Agile program management methodologies and scaled Agile practices.
Ability to manage competing priorities, resolve complex program issues, and operate effectively in a high-visibility federal program environment.

Preferred Qualifications
:

PMI Certification
FAC-P/PM Certification
TS/SCI Clearance
Master's degree preferred
Prior Department of Justice (DOJ), Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), or federal law enforcement IT experience strongly preferred

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:

Promote company Core Values to foster and safeguard Company culture

Proven ability to lead Project Managers in a fast-paced, high-volume project environment

Demonstrated professionalism and ability to communicate effectively with executives, customers, Project Managers, field supervision, vendors, subcontractors, and craft personnel
Ability to work under time constraints, respond to changing requirements, andmaintaina positive,solutions-focused leadership style
Strong oral and written communication skills, including clear customer updates, internal escalation, meeting leadership, and documentation review
Disciplined, detail oriented, organized, self-driven, and comfortable owning results through others
Demonstrated ability to resolve complex scheduling conflicts, scope issues, site coordination challenges, customer escalations, and resource constraints
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and project/job cost platforms such as Procore, Bluebeam, Viewpoint Vista, or similar systems
Entrepreneurial mindset witha high levelof motivation and the ability tooperateindependently while building alignment across the team

Experience and Education:

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree in construction management, business, engineering, information technology, telecommunications, or a related discipline is a plus, but equivalent hands-on data center, cabling, low-voltage, or field leadership experience will be given full consideration
Minimum5+ years of project or program delivery experience, preferably in datacenter, structured cabling, low-voltage, telecommunications, fiber/copper infrastructure, or mission-critical environments
Experience leading Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Project Coordinators, field leaders, or multi-project delivery teams is strongly preferred
Demonstrated experience managing or overseeing multiple concurrent projects at various stages of intake, planning, execution, closeout, and billing

Proven ability to use project management, scheduling, reporting, or job cost systems to manage a multi-project workload and provideaccurateforecasts
OSHA-30 Hour certificationrequired. If not certified at time of hire, certification must be obtained within the first six (6) months of employment

Responsabilidades Clave:

Liderazgo Estratégico del Programa: Definir la visión, estrategia y hoja de ruta del programa de migración SAP S/4HANA, asegurando su alineación con los objetivos generales del negocio del cliente.
Gestión Integral del Programa: Supervisar y dirigir todas las fases del programa, desde la planificación y el diseño hasta la ejecución, el despliegue y el soporte post-implementación.
Coordinación de Equipos: Liderar y motivar a equipos multidisciplinares (internos, externos y del cliente) involucrados en el programa, fomentando un ambiente de colaboración y alto rendimiento.
Gobierno del Programa (PMO): Establecer y mantener un marco de gobierno robusto para el programa, definiendo roles, responsabilidades, procesos de toma de decisiones, y mecanismos de control y seguimiento.
Planificación Integrada: Desarrollar y gestionar planes de programa detallados, incluyendo alcance, cronograma, presupuesto, recursos, riesgos y comunicaciones.
Gestión de Riesgos y Problemas: Identificar, evaluar y mitigar proactivamente los riesgos y problemas del programa, desarrollando planes de contingencia y asegurando su resolución efectiva.
Gestión de Stakeholders: Establecer y mantener relaciones sólidas con todos los stakeholders clave del programa, asegurando una comunicación fluida, transparente y regular sobre el progreso, los hitos y los desafíos.
Gestión de Cambios: Liderar la estrategia de gestión del cambio organizacional y técnico asociada a la migración a SAP S/4HANA, asegurando la adopción exitosa de la nueva solución por parte de los usuarios finales.
Calidad y Cumplimiento: Asegurar que todas las entregas del programa cumplen con los estándares de calidad definidos y las normativas aplicables.
Reporting y Comunicación: Elaborar informes periódicos sobre el estado del programa para la alta dirección y otros stakeholders relevantes, destacando el progreso, los riesgos, los problemas y las desviaciones.
Mejora Continua: Identificar y proponer oportunidades de mejora en los procesos y metodologías de gestión de programas.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary: The Senior Program Manager serves as the primary customer interface and point of contact accountable for ensuring programs meet cost, schedule, and performance requirements. This role provides guidance and solutions to program teams in ways that promote PDA’s culture, oversees the progress of program operations, and leads staff across multiple disciplines to deliver results in a timely manner. The Senior Program Manager also develops efficient strategies and tactics directed at growing the business.
Responsibilities: ·       Direct and coordinate program activities, leading and motivating teams to complete assigned work on time, to specification, and with accuracy and efficiency.
·       Address customer questions, concerns, and complaints throughout the program, and serve as an intake point for issues between scheduled reviews so that nothing affecting scope, schedule, cost, or deliverables is held until the next meeting.
·       Plan and manage program milestones, deadlines, and activities, including maintaining and updating the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and tracking deliverable status across functional groups.
·       Manage Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) due dates and submission tracking with a zero-miss standard.
·       Manage program budgets and cost accounts, control expenditures in accordance with budget allocations, develop Estimates at Completion (EAC), and prepare written explanations of cost variances (labor hours and dollars expended against authorized budgets).
·       Identify and manage program risks, issues, and opportunities; proactively flag schedule risks and develop mitigation plans.
·       Make resource allocation recommendations and flag staffing needs.
·       Review reports and records of program activities to track progress toward program objectives, adjust methodology as needed, and assess program performance periodically and at completion.
·       Schedule and facilitate meetings with agendas and defined goals; prepare meeting minutes, weekly status reports, and formal correspondence.
·       Participate in Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) and technical reviews (e.g., System Requirements Review, Critical Design Review).
·       Mentor and develop less experienced Program and Project Managers, reviewing and correcting their work products (e.g., IMS updates, status reports, risk entries) before they are escalated further.
·       Perform other related duties as assigned.
Requirements: ·       Proven experience as a Program Manager, with a thorough understanding of program management techniques and methods.
·       Working knowledge of formal Risk, Issue, and Opportunity (RIO) management practices, including the distinction between risks (potential future events) and issues (events that have already occurred).
·       Familiarity with government contract management fundamentals, including Contract Work Breakdown Structure (CWBS) development and subcontract management practices.
·       Working knowledge of Configuration Management (CM) processes and Engineering Change Proposal (ECP) / Configuration Control Board (CCB) workflows.
·       Excellent knowledge of MS Office Suite; working knowledge of project management software (e.g., MS Project, Basecamp) is a strong advantage.
·       Experience with earned value management (EVM) or similar cost/schedule performance measurement systems is preferred.
·       Eligibility for and ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret personnel security clearance is required; U.S. citizenship is required to support the clearance requirement.
Core Competencies: ·       Understanding of company goals and objectives
·       Strong written and oral communication skills
·       Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, external customers, and other stakeholders
·       Outstanding leadership and organizational skills, including demonstrated supervisory or coaching experience
·       Understanding of customer requirements
·       Willingness to self-develop and maintain additional skills required to perform position
Education & Experience: ·       Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Program Management, or Project Management.
·       Minimum of 4 years’ experience as a Program Manager.
·       Prior experience managing a task area, cost account, or sub-team under a senior Program Manager (i.e., prior experience functioning at a subordinate/deputy PM level) is strongly preferred.
·       Experience on a DoD or Navy hardware/engineering services contract preferred; familiarity with submarine combat systems, sonar systems, or similar NAVSEA programs is a plus.
·       Working knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulation requirements.
·       Project Management Professional (PMP) certification desired but not required.

Work Environment: This role is performed in a professional office setting and may offer a hybrid work schedule based on department and business needs. Some roles may be required to be in office only. Standard business hours apply. Minimal travel may be required for meetings or company events. The position involves regular computer use, email communication, and interaction with internal and external stakeholders in both in-person and virtual settings. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.
Salary & Benefits: Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience and education. Employees may be eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:
•          Medical, dental, and vision insurance
•          Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
•          401(k) retirement plan with company contribution
•          Health Savings Account (HSA) with select health plans
•          Company paid life insurance
•          Short-term and long-term disability
•          Annual performance bonus
Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on full-time or part-time employment status and employment classification, in accordance with company policy.

Location

This is a remote role.

Join a dynamic team driving large-scale Siemens Teamcenter PLM transformation programs for leading global organizations including PLM implementation, enhancement, and transformation initiatives.
This role is focused on project execution, delivery management, stakeholder coordination, governance, and risk management.
Candidates should be strong project leaders capable of driving complex, cross-functional programs involving business, engineering, IT, and vendor teams.
In this role, you will lead strategic Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) initiatives that help engineering and business teams improve collaboration, streamline processes, and accelerate innovation.
As a Junior Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing project delivery, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring successful execution of Teamcenter implementation and enhancement programs.
This is an excellent opportunity for a delivery-focused project leader who enjoys working at the intersection of business, engineering, and technology while contributing to impactful digital transformation initiatives.
While familiarity with Teamcenter PLM or engineering systems is beneficial, the focus is on delivery leadership and execution, driving execution, stakeholder alignment, governance, and successful project outcomes.

Your Role

Lead the end-to-end delivery of Siemens Teamcenter PLM implementation, upgrade, and enhancement projects, ensuring quality execution and stakeholder satisfaction.
Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, and dependencies to deliver projects on time and within scope.
Coordinate business, engineering, IT, and third-party vendor teams to drive seamless collaboration and ensure successful program execution.
Facilitate project governance activities, including executive reporting, stakeholder communications, steering committee meetings, and status reviews.
Oversee testing, deployment readiness, cutover planning, and go-live activities to ensure smooth transitions and successful implementations.
Proactively identify project risks, issues, and roadblocks, and drive timely resolution through effective stakeholder engagement and management.
Build strong relationships across technical and business teams while fostering alignment, accountability, and a results-oriented delivery culture

3 - 5+ years of project management experience delivering complex enterprise technology, transformation, or engineering-related programs.
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, cross-functional teams, and competing priorities in fast-paced environments.
Strong expertise in project planning, resource coordination, risk management, and overall delivery governance.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging both technical teams and senior business leaders.
Demonstrated success working with external vendors, implementation partners, and geographically distributed teams.
Experience supporting Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Data Management (PDM), CAD integrations, or related engineering systems is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Senior Supplier Program Manager
jobs.description:
Summary

The Senior Supplier Program Manager is responsible for leading supplier performance and execution across assigned complex and high impact programs, leading supplier strategy, integration, and delivery outcomes. This role acts as the primary integrator between the Program Management Office (PMO) and supply chain ensuring alignment to program requirements, schedules, and technical expectations.

The focus is on proactive risk management, recovery execution, and cross-functional alignment, working closely with Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and Quality to ensure supplier performance supports program readiness. Operating in a program-based, design-to-order environment, this role drives and leads supplier accountability, resolves complex issues, and ensures execution across multiple programs and stakeholders.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Leads supplier integration for complex or high-risk suppliers - Drives alignment between suppliers and internal teams to ensure execution against program requirements, schedules, and technical expectations.
Owns and executes supplier strategies – including supplier engagement, execution approach, and performance expectations aligned to program goals.
Monitor delivery schedules, commitments, and execution status; identify risks, variances, and associated budget impacts.
Owns and drives the supplier risk register for assigned complex suppliers - Ensure risks are identified, assessed, and actively managed with clear mitigation plans and follow-through.
Leads supplier readiness assessments at key milestones - Evaluate readiness for design release, production, and delivery; clearly communicate risks, gaps, and required actions.
Leads supplier escalation and recovery execution - corrective actions and coordinate cross-functional recovery efforts for at-risk suppliers, including escalation support as needed.
Drive alignment between supplier plans and program schedules - Ensure supplier commitments, development plans, and execution timelines are realistic and synchronized with program needs.
Identify and influence early supplier-related risks - Surface constraints related to capacity, design maturity, sub-tier dependencies, and execution gaps to inform program decisions.
Serve as primary supplier execution interface for suppliers - Provide clear, consistent communication of supplier status, risks, and recovery actions to internal stakeholders.
Ensure supplier delivery of product and required technical/certification data - Monitor execution of hardware and associated documentation to meet program and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate supplier execution across multiple programs - Balance priorities, commitments, and risks where suppliers support multiple GTI programs.
Drive targeted supplier improvement initiatives - Lead efforts to improve schedule reliability, cycle time, and execution performance.
Provides mentorship and guidance to Specialists and Senior Specialists - Supports development of team capability and consistency in supplier integration practices.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies

Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.
Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.
Dependability - Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.
Initiative - Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.
Work Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Job Core Competencies

Cooperation – Establishes and maintains effective relations, exhibits tact and consideration, displays positive outlook and pleasant manner, offers assistance and support to co-workers, works cooperatively in group situations and works actively to resolve conflicts.
Written Communications - Writes clearly and informatively, edits work for spelling and grammar, varies writing style to meet needs, and presents numerical data effectively.
Planning & Organization – You prioritize and plan work activities, you use time efficiently, you plan for additional resources, you integrate changes smoothly, you set goals and objectives, and you work in an organized manner.
Oral Communications – You speak clearly and persuasively, you listen and get clarification, you respond well to questions, you demonstrate group presentation skills, and you participate in meetings.

Education

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field required. Advanced degree is a plus.

Experience

6-8 years of experience in supply chain, supplier management, operations, or program execution within aerospace or complex manufacturing environments
Experience managing complex suppliers, assemblies, or systems (e.g., CMS/IFE, seating, or similar integrated products)
Demonstrated ability to lead supplier performance, risk management, and recovery efforts
Experience driving cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and Program Management
Experience influencing supplier selection, planning decisions, or execution strategies
Experience working directly with supplier leadership and supporting escalation scenarios

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in aircraft interiors, completions, or highly customized aerospace products
Familiarity with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 and data-driven tools (Excel, Power BI)
Experience with structured problem-solving methods (e.g., 8D, root cause analysis)
Experience working in regulated environments (FAA, aerospace quality systems)

Certifications (Preferred)

PMP or equivalent project/program management certification
APICS (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent supply chain certification
Lean / Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company/foreign government/foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong understanding of supplier performance, risk management, and execution in complex manufacturing environments
Ability to lead cross-functional coordination and influence stakeholders without direct authority
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to drive supplier recovery and corrective actions
Effective communication skills, including engagement with internal leadership and suppliers
Analytical mindset with ability to translate data into actionable insights (ERP, Excel, Power BI)
Working knowledge of engineering release, production readiness, and regulatory requirements (ITAR/EAR)

The expected WA salary range for this position is between $120,000.00 - $166,000.00 USD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, education, location, and other factors permitted by law. Our suite of comprehensive benefits include healthcare (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) savings plan with company match.

Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State. We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors. It’s complex work, but we work smart. In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

Big jobs and stretch assignments.

Ability to make a big, visible impact on the end product.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

We are hiring a Senior Rail Project Manager to lead client-facing delivery within our South Rail Systems Alliance portfolio, which has a growing pipeline of confirmed work.

This role responds to expanding programme demands and while the current scope focuses on rail systems, we expect an increasing proportion of civils works as the schemes develop, requiring robust integration and interface management. This role will be based in Swindon with travel expected to Cardiff and Bristol.

Here’s what you’ll do:

Lead end-to-end delivery of complex rail systems projects, with growing civils integration, ensuring outcomes meet client requirements, safety standards, cost targets, and schedule commitments.
Serve as a trusted, client-facing partner to build confidence, support co-located working in Cardiff for Burns Station, and enable future pipeline growth.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams (rail systems, civils, project controls, and EC) across locations to drive consistent performance and governance.
Act as the primary client interface, building strong relationships and trust through proactive communication and visible leadership.
Own integrated programme plans across rail systems and emerging civils scopes; manage baselines, risks, issues, and change.
Direct multidisciplinary teams across Swindon, Bristol (COLAS), and Cardiff, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
Coordinate with Enterprise Capabilities in India and project controls teams to expand support and strengthen delivery capability across the Burns programme and wider SRSA portfolio

Qualifications

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Proven experience delivering complex rail projects as a Project Manager or Senior PM, with strong client-facing leadership.
Demonstrated expertise in rail systems delivery with evidence of managing civils interfaces or multidisciplinary programmes.
Strong command of programme controls, governance, and reporting (schedule, cost, risk, change, and performance metrics).
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate in co-located, multi-organisation environments.
Ability to travel regularly between Swindon, Cardiff, and Bristol, and to attend mandatory in-person meetings (DCIs, IDC/R)

Additional Information

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025.
