Job Description

Your Role

The Cost of Health Care (COHC) & Specialty Drug Management Pharmacy team is responsible for managing the Specialty Drug strategies across the pharmacy and medical benefit and leading and implementing cost of health care initiatives.

The Program Manager, Principal will report to the Director, Pharmacy COHC & Specialty Drug Management. In this role you will be responsible for coordinating COHC operations, supporting cross-functional pharmacy affordability forums, and driving implementation of selected pharmacy initiatives that advance trend, savings, quality, and operational performance objectives. This role partners closely with pharmacy leadership, analytics, lines of business, product, actuarial, network, clinical, and COHC governance stakeholders to maintain a clear initiative roadmap, monitor program performance, and ensure timely execution of priority work.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In this role, you will:

Lead COHC operations support, including tracking of pharmacy affordability initiatives, coordination of initiative status updates, and follow-through on operational deliverables
Coordinate COHC forums, including agenda development, stakeholder preparation, meeting facilitation support, action item tracking, and alignment with related governance and line-of-business forums
Organize stakeholder deep dives on material trend drivers, emerging pharmacy opportunities, medical and pharmacy benefit drug initiatives, and priority affordability topics requiring cross-functional input
Develop, maintain, and distribute COHC program performance reporting, including initiative performance, savings versus plan, trend drivers, biosimilar adoption, implementation milestones, risks, and executive-ready summaries
Support implementation of key COHC pharmacy initiatives, including specialty drug management, biosimilar strategies, site-of-service opportunities, rebate and vendor strategies, and other roadmap priorities
Maintain the pharmacy initiative roadmap and COHC program portfolio, ensuring initiatives are documented, prioritized, assigned to accountable owners, updated for status and milestones, and aligned to annual and multi-year financial targets

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Requires a Bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree. Master’s Degree is preferred
Requires 10 years of prior relevant experience in pharmacy program development and implementation of companywide initiatives, organization development, and process improvement programs
Previous program management experience in multi-disciplinary settings
Knowledge of Blue Shield of California or similar health care organization structure
Strong business acumen with proven experience in thinking strategically
Strong data analytic and data management skills with the ability to perform analysis using summarized and/or detail claims information
Strong collaboration and partnership skills in a matrixed work environment
Excellent verbal and written skills with the ability to understand complex ideas and convey proposition statements to clinical and non-clinical audiences
Experience in driving cross functional meetings to drive resolution of issues and/or establish priorities and timelines for program implementations
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Power Point, and Excel
Detail oriented skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Ability to successfully work with other functional departments within a health plan
Ability to work independently with minimum direction or supervision
Ability to produce accurate and quality work under tight deadlines
Ability to manage challenging situations in a positive and constructive manner
Ability to exhibit a “can do” attitude and solution-oriented approach to resolve challenges
Ability to be a team player and be flexible in work assignments to provide support of peers
TQM, Six Sigma certification or Project Management certification is preferred

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

About Us

About Blue Shield of California

As of January 2025, Blue Shield of California became a subsidiary of Ascendiun. Ascendiun is a nonprofit corporate entity that is the parent to a family of organizations including Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan; Altais, a clinical services company; and Stellarus, a company designed to scale healthcare solutions. Together, these organizations are referred to as the Ascendiun Family of Companies.

At Blue Shield of California, our mission is to create a healthcare system worthy of our family and friends and sustainably affordable. We are transforming health care in a way that genuinely serves our nonprofit mission by lowering costs, improving quality, and enhancing the member and physician experience.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

Blue Shield is a U.S. News Best Company to work for, a Deloitte U.S. Best Managed Company and a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace. We were recognized by Fair360 as a Top Regional Company, and one of the 50 most community-minded companies in the United States by Points of Light. Here at Blue Shield, we strive to make a positive change across our industry and communities – join us!

Our Values:

Honest. We hold ourselves to the highest ethical and integrity standards. We build trust by doing what we say we're going to do and by acknowledging and correcting where we fall short.
Human. We strive to listen and communicate effectively, showing empathy by understanding others' perspectives.
Courageous. We stand up for what we believe in and are committed to the hard work necessary to achieve our ambitious goals.

Our Workplace Model

We believe in fostering a workplace environment that balances purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility - providing clear expectations while respecting the diverse needs of our workforce. Our workplace model is designed around intentional in-person interaction, collaboration, connection, creativity and flexibility:

For most teams, this means coming into the office two days per week.
Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location, out of state employees, and employees in certain member-facing roles should work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.
For employees with medical conditions that may impact their ability to work in-office, we are committed to engaging in an interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to ensure their work environment is conducive to their success and well-being.

The Company reserves the right to require more presence in the office based on business needs, and requirements are subject to change with periodic reviews.

About The Role

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA's Business, National Airspace, and Technical Computing Services (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation's skies safe and connected. We're looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world's most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

This position is required to be 100% on-site in Herndon, VA.

The Technical Project Manager will manage the day-to-day coordination between technical teams of Software Engineering professionals supporting a large-scale, mission-critical federal government program. Translate complex customer and technical requirements into executable work plans.
Track project progress against established milestones, KPIs, contractual requirements, and customer expectations.

Conduct annual and mid-year performance reviews, providing clear, objective, and actionable feedback aligned with employee goals and organizational expectations.
Establish individual performance objectives and ensure employee goals align with program priorities, contractual requirements, and organizational objectives.

Partner closely with vendors, engineers, and program leaders to ensure seamless execution across all technical domains.
Address employee performance issues and partnering with Human Resources when appropriate.

Develop mitigation and contingency plans to protect program milestones and customer commitments.
Maintain project risk and issue registers and ensure appropriate ownership, escalation, and resolution.
Monitor team and project performance using established metrics and KPIs.
Identify trends that may affect schedule, cost, quality, employee performance, or customer satisfaction.
Develop corrective action plans and drive issues through resolution.

Provide clear status updates and executive-level briefings covering technical progress, staffing, schedules, accomplishments, risks, issues, and upcoming milestones.
Translate complex technical information into understandable program and business impacts for senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
Ensure customer priorities and expectations are effectively communicated to assigned employees and technical teams.

Why You'll Want This Role:

Few roles offer the opportunity to apply deep technical and project management expertise at a scale that truly matters. In this position, your leadership directly supports aviation safety modernization across the National Airspace System.

Your work will:

Influence systems relied upon by millions of travelers every day
Support FAA initiatives that enhance safety, capacity, and resilience
Place you at the center of high-profile, mission-critical programs

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
*To access Dayforce at its best, log in from the latest version of Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge. *

Boardwalk is a limited partnership operating in the midstream portion of the natural gas and natural gas liquids industry, providing transportation and storage services for our customers. Our 14,000 miles of pipeline and storage assets provide diverse market connectivity to producers and end-users who need reliable sources of natural gas for power generation, home heating or petrochemical feedstocks. We have the experience, knowledge, and flexibility to design service offerings and create system enhancements tailored to our customers’ needs throughout the 13 states in which we operate. As an organization focused on sustainability, we are committed to protecting the environment while delivering this energy source. This commitment is made to our customers, employees, and the communities in which we operate. We incorporate environmental stewardship, safety, and compliance into our day-to-day operations and seek to strengthen and support the communities we serve. Additional information about the company can be found online at www.bwpipelines.com.

We are currently looking for a Senior IT Project Manager for our Houston, TX office.

Position Description

The Senior IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives that support the company’s business systems, applications, and innovation objectives. This individual ensures that solutions are delivered within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, security, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role and may manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

Unlike traditional project management roles, this position requires a proactive, execution-focused leader who not only manages timelines, scope, and risks but also actively partners with stakeholders and technical teams to drive decisions, resolve issues, remove obstacles, coordinate business and technical resources, and maintain forward momentum throughout the project lifecycle.

The successful candidate combines disciplined project management practices with strong business acumen, technical understanding, consultative problem-solving skills, and a modern approach to delivery. This includes appropriately leveraging Agile, hybrid, and traditional methodologies, as well as AI-enabled tools, automation, and data-driven insights to improve project performance and organizational effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery

Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex IT projects involving enterprise applications, business systems, data and analytics platforms, software development, cloud solutions, and related technologies.
Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously while maintaining appropriate focus on priorities, risks, and business outcomes.
Manage projects throughout the complete lifecycle, including initiation, planning, requirements definition, solution evaluation, design, development, testing, implementation, stabilization, and transition to production support.
Develop project charters that clearly define business objectives, scope, expected benefits, success measures, assumptions, constraints, preliminary costs, and governance requirements.
Establish and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, milestones, dependencies, and critical-path activities.
Select and apply Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, or other delivery approaches based on the needs, complexity, and risk profile of each initiative.
Maintain accountability for project commitments and ensure assigned team members understand their roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and deadlines.

Hands-On Execution and Problem Resolution

Actively drive project execution by facilitating decisions, resolving issues, removing obstacles, and coordinating actions across business, IT, and vendor teams.
Bring structure, clarity, and forward momentum to complex or ambiguous situations.
Identify potential delivery problems early and work with appropriate stakeholders to develop and implement practical solutions.
Challenge assumptions constructively and ensure project decisions are supported by appropriate business, technical, financial, and operational analysis.
Escalate significant risks, issues, resource constraints, and decisions in a timely manner, with clearly defined options and recommendations.

Business and Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as a primary liaison between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, project sponsors, and executive leadership.
Build productive relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels and create shared accountability for project outcomes.
Facilitate project initiation meetings, steering committee meetings, status reviews, and executive briefings.
Develop clear, concise, and audience-appropriate communications regarding project status, accomplishments, decisions, milestones, risks, issues, financial performance, and upcoming activities.
Promote timely decision-making and build consensus across groups with differing priorities or perspectives.

Financial, Resource, and Vendor Management

Develop and manage project budgets covering internal labor, external labor, software, hardware, cloud services, consulting, and other capital or operating expenditures.
Monitor project expenditures against approved budgets and provide accurate monthly forecasts, variance explanations, and estimates to complete.
Coordinate resource assignments across functional teams and proactively address capacity, capability, or scheduling constraints.
Manage vendor participation, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and contractual commitments in coordination with IT leadership, Procurement, Legal, and other appropriate functions.
Review vendor estimates, statements of work, project schedules, and deliverables to ensure they are complete, realistic, and aligned with project objectives.
Hold internal and external resources accountable for agreed-upon commitments and quality expectations.

Risk, Governance, and Change Management

Proactively identify, assess, document, and mitigate project risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and decisions.
Manage project scope and changes through established governance and change-control processes.
Assess the impact of proposed changes on business value, timeline, cost, resources, quality, security, contracts, and operational readiness.
Facilitate planning, coordination and delivery of organizational change management communications and training initiatives to help ensure end user adoption of implemented technology solutions.
Ensure adherence to IT PMO methodologies, governance standards, approval requirements, reporting expectations, and documentation practices.
Provide transparent, accurate, and data-driven reporting to sponsors, steering committees, IT leadership, and other stakeholders.
Maintain complete and current project documentation in designated repositories.
Ensure required project approvals, stage gates, quality reviews, and control activities are completed and documented.

Solution Quality and Implementation Readiness

Oversee planning and execution of system testing, user acceptance testing, data conversion and production cutover / release activities to ensure they are effective and appropriately controlled, coordinated and documented.
Ensure implementation plans include defined responsibilities, dependencies, contingency procedures, communication protocols, validation activities, and rollback plans when appropriate.
Facilitate production-readiness reviews and ensure open defects, risks, and operational concerns are understood and appropriately addressed before implementation.
Coordinate a structured handoff to application support, infrastructure, cybersecurity, service management, and other operational teams.
Monitor post-implementation stabilization and ensure outstanding issues are assigned, prioritized, and resolved.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

Use modern project delivery tools, AI-enabled capabilities, automation, and analytics to improve planning, forecasting, documentation, reporting, risk identification, and team productivity.
Identify opportunities to streamline project processes, reduce administrative effort, improve transparency, and accelerate decision-making.
Develop and use meaningful performance measures to evaluate project health, delivery predictability, business value, stakeholder engagement, and implementation readiness.
Share lessons learned, reusable practices, templates, and delivery insights across the PMO and broader IT organization.
Conduct post-implementation reviews to evaluate project outcomes, benefits realization, delivery effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.
Support the continued development and adoption of effective project management standards and practices.

Required Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Eight or more years of progressively responsible IT project management experience.
Recent experience leading complex enterprise application, business systems, software, data, or technology projects.
Experience leading the full project lifecycle, including budgets, resources, vendors, risks, scope, implementation, and executive reporting.
Proven ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives with competing priorities.
Demonstrated ability to drive decisions, resolve issues, and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Experience with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.

Preferred Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Prior consulting experience.
Experience in the energy, midstream, pipeline, utility, industrial, or other regulated industry.
Familiarity with industry regulations and standards such as FERC, PHMSA, DOT, NAESB, and SOX.
Experience with Software-as-a-Service, cloud deployments, enterprise software implementations, data and analytics platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, application development, or DevOps initiatives.
Experience with enterprise platforms such as ERP systems, commercial systems, ETRM platforms, Maximo, SharePoint, Pega, data platforms, or similar business-critical technologies.

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

Preferred Education

Project Management Professional certification.
Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or similar delivery certification.

Additional Information

Boardwalk Pipelines, LP, maintains a drug-free workplace and will require pre-employment drug & substance abuse testing before hiring.

Boardwalk Pipelines, LP, is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.description:
About Cognizant Corporate

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values.

About The Role

As a Manager, Physical Security, North America, you will lead the physical security program across the United States and Canada. You will be accountable for protecting Cognizant associates, visitors, facilities, assets, operations, and reputation through consistent standards, proactive risk management, reliable vendor performance, audit readiness, compliance oversight, and coordinated incident response.

You will be a key member of the CREWS organization, reporting to the Senior Director of CREWS and collaborating with Corporate Security, Global Workplace Services/CREWS, Legal, Human Resources, Business Units, SOACC, Facilities, Internal Audit, Compliance, Information Security, vendors, landlords, and law enforcement and emergency response agencies. You will have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and continuously improve regional physical security programs while upholding our commitment to quality and continuous learning.

In This Role, You Will

Lead the execution and continuous improvement of physical security programs, policies, standards, strategies, controls, and operations across North America. Support office openings, mergers and acquisitions, closures, relocations, renovations, special events, executive visits, travel and event security needs, and high-risk operations.
Own and deploy the regional physical security governance framework. Establish measurable security controls, conduct risk-based assessments, maintain audit-ready documentation, and track findings, compliance gaps, exceptions, risk treatments, and corrective actions through closure.
Manage regional guarding operations and oversee security vendors and integrators, including contracts, staffing models, training, service quality, performance, escalation practices, emergency response support, cost controls, onboarding, pricing reviews, and continuous improvement.
Oversee access control, CCTV and video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, badging, third-party alarm monitoring, and related physical security technologies in coordination with SOACC, IT, CREWS, and technology partners.
Lead or support incident response, investigations, emergency management, workplace violence prevention, theft and loss response, threat escalation, crisis coordination, training and awareness, business continuity, resiliency, and other projects requiring physical security risk management.
Develop and closely manage the regional annual OPEX and CAPEX budget and forecast. Prepare an annual executive-level program report covering budgets, operational improvements, risks and gaps, incidents, audits, vendor performance, and recommendations for the following year.
Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, commit to continuous learning, take ownership, and build strong relationships to support business strategy and impactful work.

What you must have to be considered

A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in corporate security, physical security, law enforcement, military, government, investigations, risk management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing physical security programs across multiple countries, cultures, regulatory environments, and facility types.
Strong knowledge of physical security controls and technologies, including access control, CCTV and video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, guard force operations, badging, and control room or SOACC coordination.
Expertise in physical security risk assessments, vulnerability analysis, control testing, mitigation planning, documentation, and reporting.
Working knowledge of governance, risk, and compliance practices, including audit evidence management, control ownership, policy compliance, remediation tracking, and executive reporting.
Experience supporting internal audits, client audits, regulatory reviews, investigations, and corrective action plans.
Proven leadership, vendor management, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Strong digital skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office, reporting tools, dashboards, security technology platforms, and incident or case management systems.
Sound judgment, discretion, integrity, confidentiality, and the ability to make timely decisions in complex or sensitive situations.
The ability to influence, build consensus, and communicate effectively with senior leaders, site leaders, vendors, clients, and public safety partners.
A strong sense of ownership, a desire to create meaningful outcomes, and a passion for work that serves customers, communities, or global challenges.
The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

These will help you succeed

A bachelor’s degree.
A professional security certification such as CPP, PSP, PCI, or an equivalent credential.
Experience managing security programs across the United States, Canada, and Latin America.
Spanish and/or Portuguese language proficiency.
Experience building relationships with law enforcement, intelligence, emergency response, public safety, landlord security, and industry partners.
An interest in evaluating and applying new technologies, including AI, to improve operational efficiency.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary And Other Compensation

Applications will be accepted until October 28,2026.

The annual salary for this position is between $100,000 - $110,000, depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking an experienced Deputy Program Manager (DPM)
for the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Network Operations Center (NOC). The DPB will serve as the second-in-command for a large-scale, mission-critical IT network operations support contract. The DPM organizes, directs, and manages contract operation support functions involving multiple, complex, and inter-related project tasks across geographically dispersed locations. This individual maintains senior-level client relationships, drives program performance, and ensures delivery of all contractual obligations on time and within budget.

The DPM acts with full delegated authority in the absence of the Program Manager and serves as a key liaison between Contractor personnel, government stakeholders, and senior leadership within the CBP organization.

This position requires full-time, on-site presence
at the designated CBP NOC facility in Ashburn, VA.

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

Organize and delegate responsibilities to subordinates; oversee the successful and timely completion of all assigned tasks and deliverables.

Program Leadership & Oversight
Organize, direct, and manage all contract operation support functions for the CBP NOC program, encompassing multiple complex and interdependent project tasks.
Oversee day-to-day operations of contract support teams deployed across multiple sites and operational environments.
Assume full Program Manager responsibilities and authority in the PM's absence. Lead, mentor, and manage multi-disciplinary teams of contract support personnel at multiple locations, ensuring staffing levels, skill alignment, and performance standards are maintained.

Foster a high-performance culture aligned with Contractor and government mission priorities.

Client Interface & Stakeholder Engagement
Maintain and manage the client interface at senior levels of the CBP organization, including SES-level and executive government counterparts.
Meet regularly with customer and Contractor personnel to formulate and review task plans, deliverable schedules, and program milestones.
Serve as an escalation point for program-related issues, risks, and decisions requiring senior-level resolution.
Lead customer discussions with confidence and candor, including difficult conversations about performance, risk, and the path to resolution.
Build strong working relationships across Peraton, subcontractor teams, and CBP. Listen to technical staff, remove obstacles, and hold teams accountable without creating friction.
Planning & Deliverable Management
Collaborate with the Program Manager and functional leads to develop, review, and update Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), Program Management Plans (PMPs), and other contractual deliverables.
Ensure all Program Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) elements are properly resourced, tracked, and reported.
Schedule, Cost & Performance Management
Ensure strict conformance with program task schedules, cost baselines, and performance metrics.
Monitor program Earned Value Management (EVM) indicators and other KPIs to identify variances and implement corrective actions proactively.
Establish and maintain comprehensive technical and financial reports that communicate program health and progress to both internal management and government customers.
Risk & Issue Management
Identify, assess, and manage program risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation and contingency plans.
Maintain a program risk register and provide regular risk briefings to government and Contractor leadership.
Stay close to NOC operations. Understand major incidents, recurring network issues, monitoring gaps, and engineering dependencies well enough to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.
Process Improvement & Compliance
Ensure all program activities comply with applicable federal regulations, DHS/CBP policies, and contract requirements.
Champion continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, service quality, and cost effectiveness across the NOC program.
Identify customer needs and work being performed outside the current contract scope. Bring those findings to the Program Manager and growth team with a clear technical and business case.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

High School diploma/equivalent and 12 years of experience, including experience in technical leadership, supervision, or management.
Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a DHS CBP Clearance.
Experience in IT program/project management, with demonstrated experience managing large-scale, complex network operations or IT infrastructure programs for federal government clients.
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Demonstrated experience managing teams across multiple locations in a matrixed or distributed environment.
Proven track record of maintaining senior-level government client relationships and successfully delivering programs within scope, schedule, and budget.
Strong knowledge of IT network operations concepts, NOC environments, ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL), and federal IT acquisition/delivery standards.
Experience with federal contract management, including FAR/DFAR compliance, deliverable management, and government reporting requirements.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams through high pressure incidents and build trust with government customers. Must be able to explain complex network issues clearly, work across organizational boundaries, and turn discussions into decisions and follow through.
Demonstrated experience with program planning, risk and issue management, resource planning, performance management, and operational oversight.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience supporting DHS, CBP, or other federal law enforcement / border security agency IT programs.
ITIL v4 Foundation certification or higher.
CCNA or comparable network certification.
Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) and integrated program performance reporting.
Active DHS Suitability or CBP-level background investigation.
Direct experience with enterprise network engineering, NOC operations, or network architecture is strongly preferred.

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

You are equally comfortable managing a project plan and risk log and holding a credible technical conversation with a security architect about zero-trust design or CI/CD pipeline controls.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of DevEx, DevOps, DevSecOps, SSDLC, Security Architecture, and AI Enablement projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Coordinate multiple cross-functional workstreams, identify delivery risks, and proactively coordinate resolution across stakeholders spanning engineering, architecture, security, and platform teams.
Serve as Scrum Master for Agile delivery teams, removing impediments and helping teams improve delivery effectiveness.
Support initiatives that improve software delivery processes and partner with delivery teams to onboard and adopt centralized offerings and standards.
Coordinate projects that strengthen Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices, including the integration of security controls (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning) into CI/CD pipelines across engineering teams.
Coordinate with security architecture, engineering, and platform teams on projects advancing cloud security architecture, policy-as-code, automated compliance validation, and zero-trust principles across identity, network, and workloads.
Support security architecture and risk discussions during system design, helping translate technical scan results and architectural findings into risk narratives for stakeholder and executive reporting.
Support the rollout and adoption of AI-powered software engineering capabilities, including AI-assisted security operations such as threat detection, anomaly detection, and alert triage.
Partner with engineering, architecture, security, privacy, and risk teams to support responsible AI adoption and the secure evaluation of AI pipelines and models.
Facilitate pilot programs and proof-of-concepts involving Frontier AI technologies that improve software development, testing, documentation, automation, security operations, and operational efficiency.
Help development and security teams identify opportunities to leverage AI safely and effectively while complying with enterprise governance requirements.
Contribute to security standards, frameworks, and governance, and track project KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive reporting.

What Success Looks Like

Projects delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.
Security controls seamlessly integrated into CI/CD pipelines with reduced vulnerabilities through automated detection and remediation.
Measurable adoption of AI-driven engineering and security insights that improve delivery speed and response time.
Secure, scalable delivery practices that support business innovation, backed by strong stakeholder alignment and reporting.

Solid working knowledge of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), vulnerability management, and remediation workflows.
Strong project management fundamentals: planning, scheduling, risk and dependency management, and status reporting.
Proven Scrum Master capability — facilitation, coaching, and removing impediments for Agile delivery teams.
Working understanding of application and cloud security architecture, DevSecOps automated gating, and zero-trust principles — enough to coordinate, translate, and track technical work without performing the hands-on architecture work.
Ability to help translate technical scan results and architectural findings into risk narratives for non-technical and executive audiences.
Experience leading initiatives involving Frontier AI, AI enablement, and AI-assisted security operations.
Ability to influence executives, directors, architects, security teams, and engineering leaders.
Strong facilitation and negotiation skills; experience driving enterprise-wide adoption initiatives and managing organizational change and resistance.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for executive audiences.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of project management experience in enterprise software delivery environments.

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. Gartner is looking for a well-rounded IT Program Manager who can provide project and program leadership for technology projects within Gartner’s Conference Technology organization. As the Global Conferences business continues to grow, our Conference Technology team will aim to deliver world-class execution, world-class digital products, and world-class data availability. The IT Program Manager role will lead a complex Portfolio of IT projects across multiple technology services. They are accountable for the quality of the results, benefits realization, timely delivery, ensuring that projects are planned and executed in a manner consistent with company strategy, commitments, goals, and standards. They will be responsible for implementing and ensuring adherence to standard Agile practices, coaching and guiding teams through continuous improvement and adoption. In this role you will be required to manage and collaborate with geographically dispersed teams. The candidate must have experience driving Agile transformations and improving organizational Agile maturity.  

What you will do:

Responsible for the oversight and management of global technology-based Project Portfolio in support of IT initiatives. Accountable for improving organizational Agile maturity and adherence to Agile practices, and for fostering an environment of collaboration and high impact results 

Enforce strategic portfolio management standards and practices, promoting transparency, execution and risk discipline across technology development work.
Analyze the scope and direction of initiatives across multiple levels of management and organizational boundaries 
Direct multiple sub-team project plans and execution efforts into a cohesive whole
Evaluate project and program performance consistently with key performance indicators 
Partner with technical leadership to report project progress to executive level and cross-team stakeholders. Leverage personal expertise to develop and present rational conclusions, recommendations and direct implementation strategies/action plans 
Facilitate the adoption of Agile methodologies, standards and practices across multiple services and ensure adherence by Technology teams.

Leverage Agile metrics like lead time, cycle time, velocity, and burn-down charts to monitor team performance and identify areas for improvement 
Identify systemic operational issues and resolve them as well as identify root causes and process improvements to present similar issues 
Responsible for the creation of long-term strategies and approaches to control and manage projects in support of complex business requirements 
Support the development of strategic and tactical planning of technology and people resources necessary for successful completion of several large-scale projects 

What you will need:

Strong IT professional with 10+ years of experience in program management. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem-solving skills along with high on ownership and accountability.            

       Must have:

10+ years of experience working with IT Development teams in project/program management capacity 
Deep expertise in Agile & Waterfall methodologies; proven track record of effectively coaching teams to achieve Agile maturity 
Demonstrated leadership skills working with matrixed teams, management and executive stakeholders in a dynamic, growth environment 
Strong ability to understand, influence and manage stakeholder expectations and to resolve issues that may affect delivery 
Strong project leadership, adept at Backlog Refinement, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Agile Team Building across multiple global teams, Release Management and Conflict Resolution 
Ability to navigate ambiguity and translate complex concepts into actionable steps
Ability to manage project financials including budget plans, monitor spend and prepare for potential risks 
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Suite, JIRA and Confluence 

Who you are:

Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field  
Demonstrated leadership skills; strong communication, collaboration, people management & influencing skills 
Able to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and multiple project deliverables 
Critical thinker, with a demonstrated ability to learn beyond formal training with a strong aptitude for delivering quality products 
Excellent communicator, both written and verbal, to all levels of the organization 
Passionate about building high-performing teams

What you will get:

Competitive compensation.
Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
Ongoing mentorship and apprenticeship; Leadership courses, development programs, technical courses, certification opportunities and more!
A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
Enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
20+ PTO days plus holidays and floating holidays in your first year.
Extensive medical, dental insurance and vision plan.
401K with corporate match, immediate vesting.
Health-and-wellness-related allowance programs.
Parental leave.
Tuition reimbursement.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Employee Assistance Program.
Gartner Gives Charity Match. And much more!

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

We are seeking a Security Project Manager - Federal Sector to support construction security operations on high-profile federal facilities projects. Associate's degree and 7+ years of experience managing complex construction, facilities, or infrastructure projects.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on mission outcomes.

Details

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.

What To Expect

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.

Candidates for this role should have Electronic Security Services Experience!

How You’ll Contribute

As a Senior Project Manager in Electronic Security Systems (ESS), you oversee all aspects of project execution—including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client satisfaction—across the entire project lifecycle, from initiation to closure. You are accountable for the successful delivery of large-scale, complex ESS projects, requiring effective delegation, diligent follow-through, and assurance of key deliverables. Your role centers on harnessing subject matter expertise, driving decision-making, and aligning cross-functional teams, all while maintaining clear and impactful communication with stakeholders and executive leadership.

The Sr PM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions with respect to cost, quality and schedule. The Sr PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project management activities. This position provides oversight and direction to a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

As a primary interface to the client, the Sr. Project Manager develops a strong long-term relationship - managing the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.

What You’ll Do

Daily activities include:

Leads the delivery of physical security systems by managing implementation, coordinating teams, and ensuring compliance with specifications, timelines, and quality standards.
Demonstrates expertise in the delivery and integration of physical security technologies, including closed-circuit television (CCTV) systems, electronic access control systems, intrusion detection alarms, and perimeter security solutions.
Must possess a strong understanding of general construction sequencing and its impact on project scheduling, risk mitigation, and potential delays. Responsible for identifying, qualifying, and quantifying construction-related risks, and communicating those risks clearly and effectively to the stakeholders in written form to support proactive planning and resolution.
Collaborates in design reviews to support accurate and comprehensive field documentation across project teams.
Demonstrated proficiency in developing schedules, establishing project baselines, and identifying, qualifying, and quantifying deviations, with clear communication of impacts to the client.
Responsible for coordinating field verification of prospective work sites, ensuring compliance with quality control requirements, confirming readiness, and documenting site conditions.
Demonstrates a strong ability to monitor and control the financial health of projects, including tracking budgets, costs, and margins. Proactively identifies financial risks and implements corrective actions to prevent margin erosion, ensuring profitability and alignment with financial targets.
Proactively identifies potential customer concerns and addresses them before they escalate into issues. Delivers thoughtful, comprehensive solutions to both clients and internal stakeholders, fostering trust and ensuring a smooth project experience.
Provides flexible, on-demand support to team members, proactively assisting with tasks, problem-solving, and resource coordination to help ensure project success and team efficiency. Demonstrates a collaborative mindset and a willingness to step in wherever needed to keep work progressing and goals on track.
Partners with the site supervisor to establish and drive the project’s work plan and schedule, ensuring alignment with overall project goals and timelines.
Coordinates stakeholder activities to enable system programming and final checkout of systems.
Requires proven experience in coordinating all critical activities involved in the successful commissioning of security systems, including planning, execution, testing, and documentation. The candidate must ensure systems are fully operational, meet design specifications, and are ready for client handover.
Works closely with the site supervisor, general contractor, and end user to develop and manage a comprehensive punch list of outstanding tasks following substantial completion. Ensures timely resolution of remaining items to support project closeout and client satisfaction.
Facilitates project turnover and training sessions with clients, and service team.

Use of PPE is usually required on job sites. The environment may include hospital and medical facilities. The employee can typically spend at least 40% of their time on their feet and be required to mobile around the construction site. The employee must have the ability to occasionally climb ladders, use stairs and lift and/or move materials up to 20 pounds in construction areas. The individual is regularly required to use keyboards, test equipment and controls required for SI installation projects. Specific vision abilities required for this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision and depth vision. When not on construction sites, the employee will experience normal office conditions and be required to use office equipment such as computers, peripherals, etc.

Travel:  Frequent travel by car and occasional airplane trips are required. Employees must possess a valid driver’s license in their state of residence. Project Management experience with large, complex technical projects within an at-scale program

Certified Security Project Manager – CSPM

How You’ll Contribute

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.

The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.

What You’ll Do

Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.

Complexity

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence, and people management skills. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.

Decision Making Authority

Takes full ownership of project
Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.

Maintain and wear appropriate PPE as the job and tasks require it.

Knowledgeable of broadcast operations and technologies.
Comfortable with hardware and software-based solutions.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Supervisory and people skills.
Ability to manage design/build projects for the Media business unit when not managing consulting projects.

A senior project manager typically has these base skills.

Focused on clients and able to understand how they can use solutions to meet their business needs.
Approachable; works well on teams. Is a natural leader.

Personally organized, manages time well, and sets clear priorities. Sets an example for preparation, punctuality, and professional appearance.

As Global Client Implementation Manager, you will lead the end-to-end implementation of new client relationships and new-country expansions—from contract execution through operational readiness. You will ensure the right stakeholders, systems, approvals, processes, and compliance requirements are aligned and completed before recruiting begins.
Serving as a key implementation partner to the client and the internal project lead, you will coordinate across Sales, Legal, Finance, Recruiting, Technology, and regional operations to deliver a seamless and consistent onboarding experience. You will also help strengthen and scale Infotree’s global implementation methodology by developing playbooks, governance, automation, and best practices that support consistent execution across regions.

Key Responsibilities

RFI/RFP & Pre-Implementation Support
Assist in responding to RFIs/RFPs and other pre-implementation client requests, partnering with Sales, Account Management, and appropriate functional and regional teams.
Provide operational input on implementation approach, timelines, country capabilities, workforce models, systems, compliance requirements, and delivery considerations.

Lead the implementation lifecycle from signed agreement through operational readiness, go-live, and successful post launch to handoff to Recruiting/Account Management.
Develop and manage implementation plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, risks, and launch readiness activities across multiple concurrent global implementations.
Lead implementation and governance meetings with internal stakeholders and client project teams, ensuring clear accountability for deliverables, timelines, and open issues.
Maintain implementation status reporting, risk and action logs, and executive updates, proactively driving resolution of or escalating issues that could impact launch.
Conduct formal implementation handoffs to ensure Recruiting and Account Management teams have the documentation, system access, client requirements, billing setup, and operational instructions needed for ongoing delivery.
Lead post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and improve future implementations.

Partner with Technology, Finance, Recruiting, and client system administrators to validate system access, integrations, workflows, reporting requirements, and readiness prior to launch.
Document client-specific workflows and configurations and identify opportunities to standardize, automate, or streamline implementation activities.

Client Implementation Support & Operational Excellence

Serve as a coordination point for post-implementation client needs, including existing client surveys (risk, compliance, etc.) and amendments to MSAs, SOWs, country-specific addenda, and related contractual documentation, coordinating with Account Management and functional teams and tracking redlines, approvals, and signatures through completion.
Build effective working relationships with client procurement, HR, operations, and other implementation stakeholders and support implementation-related needs throughout the client lifecycle.
Develop and maintain standardized global implementation methodologies, templates, governance processes, and playbooks.
Monitor implementation performance and identify process, automation, and technology improvements that strengthen implementation quality, reduce onboarding timelines, and support Infotree's evolving global operating model.

Global Country Expansion & Operational Readiness

jobs.title: Sr Project Manager - IT
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Project Manager (Technical)
to lead the delivery of complex, cross-functional technology projects that support our retail business spanning eCommerce, supply chain, store systems, infrastructure, and enterprise technology.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will own projects end to end: partnering with engineering, product, business, and other Technology teams to define scope and delivery plans, manage schedules and budgets, coordinate resources and dependencies, mitigate risks and issues, and drive projects through implementation.

You will operate in a fast-paced environment where you'll need technical fluency to engage engineering and Technology teams credibly, strong project leadership to bring structure to complex work, and the influence skills to align teams around shared project outcomes.

This is an on-site position located in Springfield, MO. Remote work is not an option for this role.

Essential Job Functions

Own end-to-end delivery of complex technology projects across Technology and business functions, from initiation through implementation and closure, ensuring delivery of intended business outcomes.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, including scope, schedules, milestones, resources, dependencies, budgets, and success criteria, using the methodology best suited to the work.
Drive cross-functional execution across engineering, infrastructure, QA, security, data, architecture, and business teams, keeping teams aligned on priorities, deliverables, and commitments.
Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate with clarity and drive issues toward resolution.
Engage with Technology teams to understand how architecture, integrations, networking, hardware, infrastructure, security, and other technical considerations affect project delivery.
Coordinate owning and executing teams to ensure cross-team resource needs, deliverables, and dependencies are identified and incorporated into project plans.
Establish and report project health metrics and provide clear, concise written and verbal status communications to stakeholders and leadership.
Develop and manage project budgets, monitor actuals and forecasts against plan, and communicate financial status and impacts.
Facilitate project meetings and working sessions, including planning, cross-team coordination, risk/issue resolution, decision-making, and project governance forums.
Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to adapt project plans when priorities, requirements, or constraints change while maintaining focus on intended outcomes.
Coordinate with QA and delivery teams to ensure test strategy, release readiness, implementation planning, and acceptance criteria are incorporated into the project plan.
Coordinate third-party vendor participation, including deliverables, timelines, dependencies, risks, issues, and resolution of blockers.
Drive technical and operational readiness by ensuring architecture, environments, security, testing, observability, implementation, and production support needs are identified and completed before key milestones.
Coordinate projects through architecture and technical governance reviews, ensuring required reviews and approvals are incorporated into the delivery plan.
Apply Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, or other delivery approaches based on the characteristics and needs of the project, focusing on outcomes over process.
Support portfolio planning through project estimation, scheduling, resource planning, financial planning, and identification of cross-project dependencies.
Contribute to improving project management standards, practices, and processes across the Technology organization.
Mentor Project Managers and project team members and share project management best practices.

Skills/Education/Knowledge/Experience/Abilities

Required:

Bachelor's degree in any field, or equivalent practical experience; a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline is a plus.
5+ years of project management experience leading complex, cross-functional technology projects.
Demonstrated experience independently managing large or complex technology projects from initiation through implementation.
Experience delivering projects using multiple methodologies, including Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and Waterfall/hybrid approaches.
Working knowledge of software application development concepts and the software development lifecycle.
Working knowledge of information technology concepts, including integrations, networking, hardware, infrastructure, and security.
Familiarity with quality assurance concepts and practices, including testing, release management, and production readiness.
Experience managing project risks, issues, dependencies, and stakeholder escalations across multiple Technology teams.
Experience coordinating technical governance, engineering readiness, operational readiness, and vendor activities as part of project delivery.
Experience developing and managing project schedules, resource plans, budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting.
Proficiency with project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or similar.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences and leadership.
Strong facilitation, relationship-building, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and drive accountability across teams without direct authority.
Proven track record of bringing structure to complex work and successfully delivering technology projects

Desired

Experience in retail store operations, eCommerce, omnichannel, supply chain, infrastructure, data, or enterprise technology.
Experience managing projects involving multiple Technology disciplines and significant cross-team dependencies.
Experience with scaled delivery frameworks and practices such as SAFe, DevOps, and ITIL.
Experience supporting organizational change, process improvement, or Technology transformation initiatives.
PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent certification.
Experience in the automotive aftermarket, auto parts, or retail industry.

O’Reilly Auto Parts has a proven track record of growth and stability. O’Reilly is full of successful career stories and believes in a strong promote-from-within philosophy, encouraging you to grow your career along with the organization.

Competitive Wages & Paid Time Off
Stock Purchase Plan & 401k with Employer Contributions Starting Day One

Team Member Health/Wellbeing Programs

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Contextere is an Ottawa-based AI company helping industrial and defence organizations transform
operational data into actionable intelligence for technicians, operators, maintainers, and leaders.
We work with global organizations including defence agencies, aerospace leaders, transportation
providers, and industrial enterprises to deploy practical AI solutions that deliver measurable
operational impact. As demand for our platform grows, we are seeking a Project Manager to help
coordinate strategic customer programs, strengthen delivery discipline, and support successful
execution across Contextere’s most important initiatives.

Contextere is seeking a Project Manager to support the planning, coordination,
reporting, and delivery of strategic customer and product initiatives, including
iMAPLE, DrivePilot, and MADISON-related deployments.

The successful candidate will bring project management discipline, strong communication skills,
and the ability to coordinate across business development, product, engineering, finance,
customer success, and executive leadership. This role requires someone who can bring structure
to complex initiatives, support proposal and reporting activities, and help Contextere deliver high-
quality outcomes for customers and partners.

The Opportunity
This is a high-impact coordination and execution role for someone who wants to help scale a
Canadian AI company working at the intersection of industrial innovation, national security, and
frontline workforce transformation.
As Project Manager, you will help Contextere manage strategic programs from planning through
delivery, ensuring projects remain organized, visible, and aligned with customer expectations,
internal priorities, budgets, schedules, and contractual commitments.You will work closely with cross-funtional teams while coordinating with technical, commercial,
and delivery teams. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, comfortable operating in a fast-
moving environment, and able to translate ambiguity into practical plans, clear communications,
and measurable progress.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Program and Project Management: Manage project planning, coordination, scheduling, execution
tracking, and reporting for strategic initiatives including iMAPLE, DrivePilot, and MADISON-related
customer programs.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate activities across Business Development, Product,
Engineering, Finance, Customer Success, and executive leadership to ensure alignment on priorities,
milestones, risks, and deliverables.
• Project Governance: Establish and maintain project plans, workback schedules, action registers,
risk logs, decision records, status reports, and governance routines that improve visibility and
accountability.
• Customer and Partner Coordination: Support communications with customers, partners, and
stakeholders to ensure project expectations, timelines, responsibilities, and next steps are clearly
understood.
• Project Reporting and Financial Coordination: Support project reporting, budget tracking, invoicing
inputs, milestone documentation, and financial visibility in coordination with Finance and
leadership.
• Proposal and Bid Support: Support RFP responses, proposals, innovation challenges, statements of
work, and strategic bids aligned with Contextere’s defence, industrial, transportation, and public-
sector growth objectives.
• Delivery Support: Help ensure that implementation activities, proof-of-concepts, customer
onboarding, and deployment milestones are coordinated, documented, and completed on schedule.
• Security Administration: Administer and coordinate personnel security clearances, facility security
requirements, customer security documentation, and related compliance records.
• Regulatory and Standards Compliance: Coordinate activities related to the Controlled Goods
Program, ITAR, export controls, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other applicable governance requirements.
• Audit and Assessment Readiness: Coordinate audits, assessments, and compliance reviews to
ensure Contextere maintains the security and compliance posture required by customers, partners,
and regulatory stakeholders.
• Executive Communications: Prepare concise updates, dashboards, briefing materials, meeting
notes, and decision summaries for internal leadership and external stakeholders.
• Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve project delivery discipline, reporting
consistency, internal workflows, customer handoVs, and operational maturity.
What We’re Looking For

REQUIRED
• 5+ years of experience in project management, program coordination, operations, customer delivery,
professional services, or a related role.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, deadlines, stakeholders,
and priorities simultaneously.• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear updates, reports,
meeting notes, and executive-ready materials.
• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams in a fast-moving business, technology, consulting,
defence, industrial, or enterprise software environment.
• Ability to create and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, risk logs, decision records,
and action registers.
• Strong attention to detail and comfort managing documentation, reporting, follow-ups, and project
administration.
• Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, and bring structure to ambiguous or evolving
priorities.
• Comfortable engaging with customers, partners, executives, technical teams, and internal
stakeholders.
• Proficiency with Microsoft OVice and Microsoft 365 collaboration tools, including Word, PowerPoint,
Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.
• Strong judgment, professionalism, and discretion when handling sensitive customer, partner,
commercial, or security-related information.

PREFERRED
• Experience in defence, aerospace, industrial technology, transportation, manufacturing, critical
infrastructure, enterprise software, or AI-related environments.
• Experience supporting government procurement processes, proposals, RFPs, statements of work, or
funded innovation programs.
• Familiarity with security, compliance, and controlled programs, including Controlled Goods, ITAR,
export controls, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or related frameworks.
• Experience working with project management tools, CRM systems, collaboration platforms, or
reporting dashboards.
• Experience supporting contract milestones, customer reporting, invoicing inputs, or budget tracking.
• Familiarity with agile delivery environments, software implementation projects, proof-of-concepts,
or customer onboarding.
• Security clearance eligibility or an existing security clearance is considered an asset.

Success Measures
Within the first 12 months, the successful candidate will be expected to:
• Establish consistent project management routines across key strategic initiatives.
• Improve visibility into project milestones, risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
• Support successful execution and reporting for iMAPLE, DrivePilot, and MADISON-related customer
programs.
• Strengthen project reporting, budget tracking, and coordination with Finance and leadership.
• Improve Contextere’s readiness for customer, partner, security, and compliance reviews.
• Support higher-quality proposals, bids, statements of work, and customer-facing documentation.
• Reduce execution risk by improving coordination between commercial, product, engineering, and
delivery teams.
• Build trust as a reliable internal coordinator and external-facing project representative.

Why Join Contextere?
At Contextere, you will not just help manage projects — you will help put practical AI into the hands
of the people who keep critical operations moving. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection
of industrial innovation, national security, and frontline workforce transformation.
• Shape the future of AI for the technicians, operators, maintainers, and mission teams who power the
physical world.
• Work directly with the CEO and leadership team in a high-trust, high-visibility role where your
organization, judgment, and execution discipline will matter.
• Engage with world-class defence, aerospace, transportation, and industrial organizations solving real
operational problems.
• Help turn complex programs into coordinated plans, measurable progress, and successful customer
outcomes.
• Join a Canadian AI company at a pivotal growth stage, with the opportunity to help define a category
and build lasting enterprise value.
• Make a measurable impact in a role that blends project execution, customer coordination,
operational discipline, and meaningful career growth.
