new_jobs.title: Senior Supplier Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Summary

The Senior Supplier Program Manager is responsible for leading supplier performance and execution across assigned complex and high impact programs, leading supplier strategy, integration, and delivery outcomes. This role acts as the primary integrator between the Program Management Office (PMO) and supply chain ensuring alignment to program requirements, schedules, and technical expectations.

The focus is on proactive risk management, recovery execution, and cross-functional alignment, working closely with Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and Quality to ensure supplier performance supports program readiness. Operating in a program-based, design-to-order environment, this role drives and leads supplier accountability, resolves complex issues, and ensures execution across multiple programs and stakeholders.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Leads supplier integration for complex or high-risk suppliers - Drives alignment between suppliers and internal teams to ensure execution against program requirements, schedules, and technical expectations.
Owns and executes supplier strategies – including supplier engagement, execution approach, and performance expectations aligned to program goals.
Monitor delivery schedules, commitments, and execution status; identify risks, variances, and associated budget impacts.
Owns and drives the supplier risk register for assigned complex suppliers - Ensure risks are identified, assessed, and actively managed with clear mitigation plans and follow-through.
Leads supplier readiness assessments at key milestones - Evaluate readiness for design release, production, and delivery; clearly communicate risks, gaps, and required actions.
Leads supplier escalation and recovery execution - corrective actions and coordinate cross-functional recovery efforts for at-risk suppliers, including escalation support as needed.
Drive alignment between supplier plans and program schedules - Ensure supplier commitments, development plans, and execution timelines are realistic and synchronized with program needs.
Identify and influence early supplier-related risks - Surface constraints related to capacity, design maturity, sub-tier dependencies, and execution gaps to inform program decisions.
Serve as primary supplier execution interface for suppliers - Provide clear, consistent communication of supplier status, risks, and recovery actions to internal stakeholders.
Ensure supplier delivery of product and required technical/certification data - Monitor execution of hardware and associated documentation to meet program and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate supplier execution across multiple programs - Balance priorities, commitments, and risks where suppliers support multiple GTI programs.
Drive targeted supplier improvement initiatives - Lead efforts to improve schedule reliability, cycle time, and execution performance.
Provides mentorship and guidance to Specialists and Senior Specialists - Supports development of team capability and consistency in supplier integration practices.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies

Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.
Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.
Dependability - Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.
Initiative - Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.
Work Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Job Core Competencies

Cooperation – Establishes and maintains effective relations, exhibits tact and consideration, displays positive outlook and pleasant manner, offers assistance and support to co-workers, works cooperatively in group situations and works actively to resolve conflicts.
Written Communications - Writes clearly and informatively, edits work for spelling and grammar, varies writing style to meet needs, and presents numerical data effectively.
Planning & Organization – You prioritize and plan work activities, you use time efficiently, you plan for additional resources, you integrate changes smoothly, you set goals and objectives, and you work in an organized manner.
Oral Communications – You speak clearly and persuasively, you listen and get clarification, you respond well to questions, you demonstrate group presentation skills, and you participate in meetings.

Education

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field required. Advanced degree is a plus.

Experience

6-8 years of experience in supply chain, supplier management, operations, or program execution within aerospace or complex manufacturing environments
Experience managing complex suppliers, assemblies, or systems (e.g., CMS/IFE, seating, or similar integrated products)
Demonstrated ability to lead supplier performance, risk management, and recovery efforts
Experience driving cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and Program Management
Experience influencing supplier selection, planning decisions, or execution strategies
Experience working directly with supplier leadership and supporting escalation scenarios

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in aircraft interiors, completions, or highly customized aerospace products
Familiarity with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 and data-driven tools (Excel, Power BI)
Experience with structured problem-solving methods (e.g., 8D, root cause analysis)
Experience working in regulated environments (FAA, aerospace quality systems)

Certifications (Preferred)

PMP or equivalent project/program management certification
APICS (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent supply chain certification
Lean / Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company/foreign government/foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong understanding of supplier performance, risk management, and execution in complex manufacturing environments
Ability to lead cross-functional coordination and influence stakeholders without direct authority
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to drive supplier recovery and corrective actions
Effective communication skills, including engagement with internal leadership and suppliers
Analytical mindset with ability to translate data into actionable insights (ERP, Excel, Power BI)
Working knowledge of engineering release, production readiness, and regulatory requirements (ITAR/EAR)

The expected WA salary range for this position is between $120,000.00 - $166,000.00 USD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, education, location, and other factors permitted by law. Our suite of comprehensive benefits include healthcare (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) savings plan with company match.

About Greenpoint Technologies

Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State. We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors. It’s complex work, but we work smart. In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

Big jobs and stretch assignments.
High accountability environment, with transparent decisions aligned to values, open communication, and engaged leadership.
Ability to make a big, visible impact on the end product.

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Proven experience delivering complex rail projects as a Project Manager or Senior PM, with strong client-facing leadership.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Your Role

The Cost of Health Care (COHC) & Specialty Drug Management Pharmacy team is responsible for managing the Specialty Drug strategies across the pharmacy and medical benefit and leading and implementing cost of health care initiatives.

The Program Manager, Principal will report to the Director, Pharmacy COHC & Specialty Drug Management. This role partners closely with pharmacy leadership, analytics, lines of business, product, actuarial, network, clinical, and COHC governance stakeholders to maintain a clear initiative roadmap, monitor program performance, and ensure timely execution of priority work.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. Coordinate COHC forums, including agenda development, stakeholder preparation, meeting facilitation support, action item tracking, and alignment with related governance and line-of-business forums

Support implementation of key COHC pharmacy initiatives, including specialty drug management, biosimilar strategies, site-of-service opportunities, rebate and vendor strategies, and other roadmap priorities
Maintain the pharmacy initiative roadmap and COHC program portfolio, ensuring initiatives are documented, prioritized, assigned to accountable owners, updated for status and milestones, and aligned to annual and multi-year financial targets

Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA's Business, National Airspace, and Technical Computing Services (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation's skies safe and connected. We're looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world's most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won't just support the mission you'll define it. Lead the work that keeps America flying safely.

At Peraton, we don't just manage projects we deliver the systems that protect and advance U.S. air travel. We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager - SME
to lead complex, high-visibility technology initiatives supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This role sits at the heart of aviation modernization, where disciplined execution, technical excellence, and mission impact converge. If you thrive in environments where precision matters, collaboration is essential, and your work has national significance, this role offers both challenge and purpose.

Work Location:

This position is required to be 100% on-site in Herndon, VA.

In this position, you will:

The Technical Project Manager will manage the day-to-day coordination between technical teams of Software Engineering professionals supporting a large-scale, mission-critical federal government program. This role is responsible for coordinating technical execution across cybersecurity, network infrastructure, systems integration, and testing activities while ensuring program requirements are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with customer, security, and quality standards.

Align technical delivery with long-term FAA modernization goals and program priorities.
Support requirements analysis, readiness reviews, and operational transitions.
Drive projects to successful completion while meeting FAA standards, cost targets, and delivery commitments.
Translate complex customer and technical requirements into executable work plans.
Track project progress against established milestones, KPIs, contractual requirements, and customer expectations.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

Manage the day-to-day performance, workload, priorities, and development of assigned employees.
Conduct annual and mid-year performance reviews, providing clear, objective, and actionable feedback aligned with employee goals and organizational expectations.
Establish individual performance objectives and ensure employee goals align with program priorities, contractual requirements, and organizational objectives.
Assess current and future staffing requirements based on project schedules, technical priorities, customer demand, and contractual requirements.
Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, career development, and performance feedback to strengthen individual and team performance.
Review and approve employee timecards, PTO, attendance, and other workforce-management activities.
Partner closely with vendors, engineers, and program leaders to ensure seamless execution across all technical domains.
Address employee performance issues and partnering with Human Resources when appropriate.

Risk Management with Real Impact

Anticipate and resolve technical risks, dependencies, and integration challenges.
Develop mitigation and contingency plans to protect program milestones and customer commitments.
Maintain project risk and issue registers and ensure appropriate ownership, escalation, and resolution.
Monitor team and project performance using established metrics and KPIs.
Identify trends that may affect schedule, cost, quality, employee performance, or customer satisfaction.
Develop corrective action plans and drive issues through resolution.

Trusted Stakeholder Partner

Serve as a key interface between technical teams, program leadership, subcontractors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
Provide clear status updates and executive-level briefings covering technical progress, staffing, schedules, accomplishments, risks, issues, and upcoming milestones.
Translate complex technical information into understandable program and business impacts for senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
Ensure customer priorities and expectations are effectively communicated to assigned employees and technical teams.

Why You'll Want This Role:

Boardwalk is a limited partnership operating in the midstream portion of the natural gas and natural gas liquids industry, providing transportation and storage services for our customers. This commitment is made to our customers, employees, and the communities in which we operate. We incorporate environmental stewardship, safety, and compliance into our day-to-day operations and seek to strengthen and support the communities we serve. Additional information about the company can be found online at www.bwpipelines.com.

We are currently looking for a Senior IT Project Manager for our Houston, TX office.

Position Description

The Senior IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives that support the company’s business systems, applications, and innovation objectives. This individual ensures that solutions are delivered within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, security, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role and may manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

Unlike traditional project management roles, this position requires a proactive, execution-focused leader who not only manages timelines, scope, and risks but also actively partners with stakeholders and technical teams to drive decisions, resolve issues, remove obstacles, coordinate business and technical resources, and maintain forward momentum throughout the project lifecycle.

The successful candidate combines disciplined project management practices with strong business acumen, technical understanding, consultative problem-solving skills, and a modern approach to delivery. This includes appropriately leveraging Agile, hybrid, and traditional methodologies, as well as AI-enabled tools, automation, and data-driven insights to improve project performance and organizational effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery

Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex IT projects involving enterprise applications, business systems, data and analytics platforms, software development, cloud solutions, and related technologies.
Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously while maintaining appropriate focus on priorities, risks, and business outcomes.
Manage projects throughout the complete lifecycle, including initiation, planning, requirements definition, solution evaluation, design, development, testing, implementation, stabilization, and transition to production support.
Develop project charters that clearly define business objectives, scope, expected benefits, success measures, assumptions, constraints, preliminary costs, and governance requirements.
Establish and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, milestones, dependencies, and critical-path activities.
Select and apply Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, or other delivery approaches based on the needs, complexity, and risk profile of each initiative.
Maintain accountability for project commitments and ensure assigned team members understand their roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and deadlines.

Hands-On Execution and Problem Resolution

Actively drive project execution by facilitating decisions, resolving issues, removing obstacles, and coordinating actions across business, IT, and vendor teams.
Bring structure, clarity, and forward momentum to complex or ambiguous situations.
Identify potential delivery problems early and work with appropriate stakeholders to develop and implement practical solutions.
Challenge assumptions constructively and ensure project decisions are supported by appropriate business, technical, financial, and operational analysis.
Escalate significant risks, issues, resource constraints, and decisions in a timely manner, with clearly defined options and recommendations.

Business and Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as a primary liaison between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, project sponsors, and executive leadership.
Build productive relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels and create shared accountability for project outcomes.
Facilitate project initiation meetings, steering committee meetings, status reviews, and executive briefings.
Develop clear, concise, and audience-appropriate communications regarding project status, accomplishments, decisions, milestones, risks, issues, financial performance, and upcoming activities.
Promote timely decision-making and build consensus across groups with differing priorities or perspectives.

Financial, Resource, and Vendor Management

Develop and manage project budgets covering internal labor, external labor, software, hardware, cloud services, consulting, and other capital or operating expenditures.
Monitor project expenditures against approved budgets and provide accurate monthly forecasts, variance explanations, and estimates to complete.
Coordinate resource assignments across functional teams and proactively address capacity, capability, or scheduling constraints.
Manage vendor participation, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and contractual commitments in coordination with IT leadership, Procurement, Legal, and other appropriate functions.
Review vendor estimates, statements of work, project schedules, and deliverables to ensure they are complete, realistic, and aligned with project objectives.
Hold internal and external resources accountable for agreed-upon commitments and quality expectations.

Risk, Governance, and Change Management

Proactively identify, assess, document, and mitigate project risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and decisions.
Manage project scope and changes through established governance and change-control processes.
Assess the impact of proposed changes on business value, timeline, cost, resources, quality, security, contracts, and operational readiness.
Facilitate planning, coordination and delivery of organizational change management communications and training initiatives to help ensure end user adoption of implemented technology solutions.
Ensure adherence to IT PMO methodologies, governance standards, approval requirements, reporting expectations, and documentation practices.
Provide transparent, accurate, and data-driven reporting to sponsors, steering committees, IT leadership, and other stakeholders.
Maintain complete and current project documentation in designated repositories.
Ensure required project approvals, stage gates, quality reviews, and control activities are completed and documented.

Solution Quality and Implementation Readiness

Oversee planning and execution of system testing, user acceptance testing, data conversion and production cutover / release activities to ensure they are effective and appropriately controlled, coordinated and documented.
Ensure implementation plans include defined responsibilities, dependencies, contingency procedures, communication protocols, validation activities, and rollback plans when appropriate.
Facilitate production-readiness reviews and ensure open defects, risks, and operational concerns are understood and appropriately addressed before implementation.
Coordinate a structured handoff to application support, infrastructure, cybersecurity, service management, and other operational teams.
Monitor post-implementation stabilization and ensure outstanding issues are assigned, prioritized, and resolved.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

Use modern project delivery tools, AI-enabled capabilities, automation, and analytics to improve planning, forecasting, documentation, reporting, risk identification, and team productivity.
Identify opportunities to streamline project processes, reduce administrative effort, improve transparency, and accelerate decision-making.
Develop and use meaningful performance measures to evaluate project health, delivery predictability, business value, stakeholder engagement, and implementation readiness.
Share lessons learned, reusable practices, templates, and delivery insights across the PMO and broader IT organization.
Conduct post-implementation reviews to evaluate project outcomes, benefits realization, delivery effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.
Support the continued development and adoption of effective project management standards and practices.

Required Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Eight or more years of progressively responsible IT project management experience.
Recent experience leading complex enterprise application, business systems, software, data, or technology projects.
Experience leading the full project lifecycle, including budgets, resources, vendors, risks, scope, implementation, and executive reporting.
Proven ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives with competing priorities.
Demonstrated ability to drive decisions, resolve issues, and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Experience with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.

Preferred Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Prior consulting experience.
Experience in the energy, midstream, pipeline, utility, industrial, or other regulated industry.
Familiarity with industry regulations and standards such as FERC, PHMSA, DOT, NAESB, and SOX.
Experience with Software-as-a-Service, cloud deployments, enterprise software implementations, data and analytics platforms, artificial intelligence, automation, application development, or DevOps initiatives.
Experience with enterprise platforms such as ERP systems, commercial systems, ETRM platforms, Maximo, SharePoint, Pega, data platforms, or similar business-critical technologies.

Support office openings, mergers and acquisitions, closures, relocations, renovations, special events, executive visits, travel and event security needs, and high-risk operations.
Own and deploy the regional physical security governance framework. Establish measurable security controls, conduct risk-based assessments, maintain audit-ready documentation, and track findings, compliance gaps, exceptions, risk treatments, and corrective actions through closure.
Manage regional guarding operations and oversee security vendors and integrators, including contracts, staffing models, training, service quality, performance, escalation practices, emergency response support, cost controls, onboarding, pricing reviews, and continuous improvement.
Oversee access control, CCTV and video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, badging, third-party alarm monitoring, and related physical security technologies in coordination with SOACC, IT, CREWS, and technology partners.
Lead or support incident response, investigations, emergency management, workplace violence prevention, theft and loss response, threat escalation, crisis coordination, training and awareness, business continuity, resiliency, and other projects requiring physical security risk management.
Develop and closely manage the regional annual OPEX and CAPEX budget and forecast. Prepare an annual executive-level program report covering budgets, operational improvements, risks and gaps, incidents, audits, vendor performance, and recommendations for the following year.
Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, commit to continuous learning, take ownership, and build strong relationships to support business strategy and impactful work.

What you must have to be considered

A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in corporate security, physical security, law enforcement, military, government, investigations, risk management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing physical security programs across multiple countries, cultures, regulatory environments, and facility types.
Strong knowledge of physical security controls and technologies, including access control, CCTV and video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, guard force operations, badging, and control room or SOACC coordination.
Expertise in physical security risk assessments, vulnerability analysis, control testing, mitigation planning, documentation, and reporting.
Working knowledge of governance, risk, and compliance practices, including audit evidence management, control ownership, policy compliance, remediation tracking, and executive reporting.
Experience supporting internal audits, client audits, regulatory reviews, investigations, and corrective action plans.
Proven leadership, vendor management, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Strong digital skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office, reporting tools, dashboards, security technology platforms, and incident or case management systems.
Sound judgment, discretion, integrity, confidentiality, and the ability to make timely decisions in complex or sensitive situations.
The ability to influence, build consensus, and communicate effectively with senior leaders, site leaders, vendors, clients, and public safety partners.
A strong sense of ownership, a desire to create meaningful outcomes, and a passion for work that serves customers, communities, or global challenges.
The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

These will help you succeed

A bachelor’s degree.
A professional security certification such as CPP, PSP, PCI, or an equivalent credential.
Experience managing security programs across the United States, Canada, and Latin America.
Spanish and/or Portuguese language proficiency.
Experience building relationships with law enforcement, intelligence, emergency response, public safety, landlord security, and industry partners.
An interest in evaluating and applying new technologies, including AI, to improve operational efficiency.

new_jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking an experienced Deputy Program Manager (DPM)
for the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Network Operations Center (NOC). The DPB will serve as the second-in-command for a large-scale, mission-critical IT network operations support contract. The DPM organizes, directs, and manages contract operation support functions involving multiple, complex, and inter-related project tasks across geographically dispersed locations. This individual maintains senior-level client relationships, drives program performance, and ensures delivery of all contractual obligations on time and within budget.

The DPM acts with full delegated authority in the absence of the Program Manager and serves as a key liaison between Contractor personnel, government stakeholders, and senior leadership within the CBP organization.

This position requires full-time, on-site presence
at the designated CBP NOC facility in Ashburn, VA.

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

Organize and delegate responsibilities to subordinates; oversee the successful and timely completion of all assigned tasks and deliverables.

Program Leadership & Oversight
Organize, direct, and manage all contract operation support functions for the CBP NOC program, encompassing multiple complex and interdependent project tasks.
Oversee day-to-day operations of contract support teams deployed across multiple sites and operational environments.
Assume full Program Manager responsibilities and authority in the PM's absence. Lead, mentor, and manage multi-disciplinary teams of contract support personnel at multiple locations, ensuring staffing levels, skill alignment, and performance standards are maintained.

Foster a high-performance culture aligned with Contractor and government mission priorities.

Client Interface & Stakeholder Engagement
Maintain and manage the client interface at senior levels of the CBP organization, including SES-level and executive government counterparts.
Meet regularly with customer and Contractor personnel to formulate and review task plans, deliverable schedules, and program milestones.
Serve as an escalation point for program-related issues, risks, and decisions requiring senior-level resolution.
Lead customer discussions with confidence and candor, including difficult conversations about performance, risk, and the path to resolution.
Build strong working relationships across Peraton, subcontractor teams, and CBP. Listen to technical staff, remove obstacles, and hold teams accountable without creating friction.
Planning & Deliverable Management
Collaborate with the Program Manager and functional leads to develop, review, and update Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), Program Management Plans (PMPs), and other contractual deliverables.
Ensure all Program Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) elements are properly resourced, tracked, and reported.
Schedule, Cost & Performance Management
Ensure strict conformance with program task schedules, cost baselines, and performance metrics.
Monitor program Earned Value Management (EVM) indicators and other KPIs to identify variances and implement corrective actions proactively.
Establish and maintain comprehensive technical and financial reports that communicate program health and progress to both internal management and government customers.
Risk & Issue Management
Identify, assess, and manage program risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation and contingency plans.
Maintain a program risk register and provide regular risk briefings to government and Contractor leadership.
Stay close to NOC operations. Understand major incidents, recurring network issues, monitoring gaps, and engineering dependencies well enough to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.
Process Improvement & Compliance
Ensure all program activities comply with applicable federal regulations, DHS/CBP policies, and contract requirements.
Champion continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, service quality, and cost effectiveness across the NOC program.
Identify customer needs and work being performed outside the current contract scope. Bring those findings to the Program Manager and growth team with a clear technical and business case.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

High School diploma/equivalent and 12 years of experience, including experience in technical leadership, supervision, or management.
Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a DHS CBP Clearance.
Experience in IT program/project management, with demonstrated experience managing large-scale, complex network operations or IT infrastructure programs for federal government clients.
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Demonstrated experience managing teams across multiple locations in a matrixed or distributed environment.
Proven track record of maintaining senior-level government client relationships and successfully delivering programs within scope, schedule, and budget.
Strong knowledge of IT network operations concepts, NOC environments, ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL), and federal IT acquisition/delivery standards.
Experience with federal contract management, including FAR/DFAR compliance, deliverable management, and government reporting requirements.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams through high pressure incidents and build trust with government customers. Must be able to explain complex network issues clearly, work across organizational boundaries, and turn discussions into decisions and follow through.
Demonstrated experience with program planning, risk and issue management, resource planning, performance management, and operational oversight.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience supporting DHS, CBP, or other federal law enforcement / border security agency IT programs.
ITIL v4 Foundation certification or higher.
CCNA or comparable network certification.
Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) and integrated program performance reporting.
Active DHS Suitability or CBP-level background investigation.
Direct experience with enterprise network engineering, NOC operations, or network architecture is strongly preferred.

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:
Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

new_jobs.description:
12 month contract hybrid 3 days a week onsite in Mississauga office

Job Title: Senior Project Manager – DevSecOps, Security Architecture & AI Enablement

Role Description

As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic initiatives spanning Developer Experience (DevEx), DevSecOps, Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), Security Architecture, and AI Enablement. This role combines strong project management, Agile delivery, and Scrum Master capabilities with a solid technical foundation across modern security architecture, cloud security, and DevSecOps automation.
You will work closely with developers, security architects, platform engineers, product owners, and leadership teams to deliver projects that improve developer productivity, embed security-by-design across the SDLC, and support the safe adoption of AI across engineering. You are equally comfortable managing a project plan and risk log and holding a credible technical conversation with a security architect about zero-trust design or CI/CD pipeline controls.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of DevEx, DevOps, DevSecOps, SSDLC, Security Architecture, and AI Enablement projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Coordinate multiple cross-functional workstreams, identify delivery risks, and proactively coordinate resolution across stakeholders spanning engineering, architecture, security, and platform teams.
Serve as Scrum Master for Agile delivery teams, removing impediments and helping teams improve delivery effectiveness.
Support initiatives that improve software delivery processes and partner with delivery teams to onboard and adopt centralized offerings and standards.
Coordinate projects that strengthen Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices, including the integration of security controls (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning) into CI/CD pipelines across engineering teams.
Coordinate with security architecture, engineering, and platform teams on projects advancing cloud security architecture, policy-as-code, automated compliance validation, and zero-trust principles across identity, network, and workloads.
Support security architecture and risk discussions during system design, helping translate technical scan results and architectural findings into risk narratives for stakeholder and executive reporting.
Support the rollout and adoption of AI-powered software engineering capabilities, including AI-assisted security operations such as threat detection, anomaly detection, and alert triage.
Partner with engineering, architecture, security, privacy, and risk teams to support responsible AI adoption and the secure evaluation of AI pipelines and models.
Facilitate pilot programs and proof-of-concepts involving Frontier AI technologies that improve software development, testing, documentation, automation, security operations, and operational efficiency.
Help development and security teams identify opportunities to leverage AI safely and effectively while complying with enterprise governance requirements.
Contribute to security standards, frameworks, and governance, and track project KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive reporting.

What Success Looks Like

Projects delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.
Security controls seamlessly integrated into CI/CD pipelines with reduced vulnerabilities through automated detection and remediation.
Measurable adoption of AI-driven engineering and security insights that improve delivery speed and response time.
Secure, scalable delivery practices that support business innovation, backed by strong stakeholder alignment and reporting.

Competencies

Solid working knowledge of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), vulnerability management, and remediation workflows.
Strong project management fundamentals: planning, scheduling, risk and dependency management, and status reporting.
Proven Scrum Master capability — facilitation, coaching, and removing impediments for Agile delivery teams.
Working understanding of application and cloud security architecture, DevSecOps automated gating, and zero-trust principles — enough to coordinate, translate, and track technical work without performing the hands-on architecture work.
Ability to help translate technical scan results and architectural findings into risk narratives for non-technical and executive audiences.
Experience leading initiatives involving Frontier AI, AI enablement, and AI-assisted security operations.
Ability to influence executives, directors, architects, security teams, and engineering leaders.
Strong facilitation and negotiation skills; experience driving enterprise-wide adoption initiatives and managing organizational change and resistance.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for executive audiences.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of project management experience in enterprise software delivery environments.
4+ years as a Scrum Master leading Agile delivery teams.
Proven experience managing complex technology projects involving DevSecOps, security architecture, AI initiatives, and software security/compliance programs.
Working familiarity with application security tooling and practices (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC) sufficient to track and evaluate technical delivery, gained through hands-on experience, close partnership with security architecture teams, or equivalent exposure.
Experience coordinating multiple cross-functional teams, vendors, and executive stakeholders.
Experience managing roadmaps, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive reporting.

ACCESSIBILITY

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible workplace where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported, and has the opportunity to reach their full potential. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities.

Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. For a confidential inquiry, simply email your recruiter directly or accessibility@fxinnovation.com to make arrangements.

If you have questions regarding accessible employment at Ateko please email our Human Resources team at accessibility@fxinnovation.com

new_jobs.description:
Hiring near our Irving, TX or Stamford, CT Centers of Excellence with a flexible environment.

About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About the role:

Gartner is looking for a well-rounded IT Program Manager who can provide project and program leadership for technology projects within Gartner’s Conference Technology organization. As the Global Conferences business continues to grow, our Conference Technology team will aim to deliver world-class execution, world-class digital products, and world-class data availability. The IT Program Manager role will lead a complex Portfolio of IT projects across multiple technology services. They are accountable for the quality of the results, benefits realization, timely delivery, ensuring that projects are planned and executed in a manner consistent with company strategy, commitments, goals, and standards. They will be responsible for implementing and ensuring adherence to standard Agile practices, coaching and guiding teams through continuous improvement and adoption. In this role you will be required to manage and collaborate with geographically dispersed teams. The candidate must have experience driving Agile transformations and improving organizational Agile maturity.  

What you will do:

Responsible for the oversight and management of global technology-based Project Portfolio in support of IT initiatives. Accountable for improving organizational Agile maturity and adherence to Agile practices, and for fostering an environment of collaboration and high impact results 

Enforce strategic portfolio management standards and practices, promoting transparency, execution and risk discipline across technology development work.
Analyze the scope and direction of initiatives across multiple levels of management and organizational boundaries 
Direct multiple sub-team project plans and execution efforts into a cohesive whole
Evaluate project and program performance consistently with key performance indicators 
Partner with technical leadership to report project progress to executive level and cross-team stakeholders. Leverage personal expertise to develop and present rational conclusions, recommendations and direct implementation strategies/action plans 
Facilitate the adoption of Agile methodologies, standards and practices across multiple services and ensure adherence by Technology teams. 
Provide guidance and support to Scrum Masters in Agile principles and practices 
Leverage Agile metrics like lead time, cycle time, velocity, and burn-down charts to monitor team performance and identify areas for improvement 
Identify systemic operational issues and resolve them as well as identify root causes and process improvements to present similar issues 
Responsible for the creation of long-term strategies and approaches to control and manage projects in support of complex business requirements 
Support the development of strategic and tactical planning of technology and people resources necessary for successful completion of several large-scale projects 

What you will need:

Strong IT professional with 10+ years of experience in program management. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem-solving skills along with high on ownership and accountability.            

       Must have:

10+ years of experience working with IT Development teams in project/program management capacity 
Deep expertise in Agile & Waterfall methodologies; proven track record of effectively coaching teams to achieve Agile maturity 
Demonstrated leadership skills working with matrixed teams, management and executive stakeholders in a dynamic, growth environment 
Strong ability to understand, influence and manage stakeholder expectations and to resolve issues that may affect delivery 
Strong project leadership, adept at Backlog Refinement, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Agile Team Building across multiple global teams, Release Management and Conflict Resolution 
Ability to navigate ambiguity and translate complex concepts into actionable steps
Ability to manage project financials including budget plans, monitor spend and prepare for potential risks 
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Suite, JIRA and Confluence 

Who you are:

Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field  
Demonstrated leadership skills; strong communication, collaboration, people management & influencing skills 
Able to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and multiple project deliverables 
Critical thinker, with a demonstrated ability to learn beyond formal training with a strong aptitude for delivering quality products 
Excellent communicator, both written and verbal, to all levels of the organization 
Passionate about building high-performing teams 

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles!

What you will get:

Competitive compensation.
Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
Ongoing mentorship and apprenticeship; Leadership courses, development programs, technical courses, certification opportunities and more!
A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
Enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
20+ PTO days plus holidays and floating holidays in your first year.
Extensive medical, dental insurance and vision plan.
401K with corporate match, immediate vesting.
Health-and-wellness-related allowance programs.
Parental leave.
Tuition reimbursement.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Employee Assistance Program.
Gartner Gives Charity Match. And much more!

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 108,000 USD - 148,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. Facilitates enterprise-wide security risk profiles of existing and planning operations to inform executive decision making

Position Summary

Our clients are global, and their needs often expand quickly across countries and regions. The quality of each implementation directly impacts client satisfaction, operational success, and future growth.
As Global Client Implementation Manager, you will lead the end-to-end implementation of new client relationships and new-country expansions—from contract execution through operational readiness. You will ensure the right stakeholders, systems, approvals, processes, and compliance requirements are aligned and completed before recruiting begins.
Serving as a key implementation partner to the client and the internal project lead, you will coordinate across Sales, Legal, Finance, Recruiting, Technology, and regional operations to deliver a seamless and consistent onboarding experience. You will also help strengthen and scale Infotree’s global implementation methodology by developing playbooks, governance, automation, and best practices that support consistent execution across regions.
This is a highly visible, cross-functional role requiring strong project leadership, organization, communication, and operational judgment.

Key Responsibilities

RFI/RFP & Pre-Implementation Support
Assist in responding to RFIs/RFPs and other pre-implementation client requests, partnering with Sales, Account Management, and appropriate functional and regional teams.
Provide operational input on implementation approach, timelines, country capabilities, workforce models, systems, compliance requirements, and delivery considerations.
Identify implementation risks and dependencies during the RFI/RFP process and help ensure key commitments and requirements are carried forward into implementation.

Global Implementation Leadership

Lead the implementation lifecycle from signed agreement through operational readiness, go-live, and successful post launch to handoff to Recruiting/Account Management.
Develop and manage implementation plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, risks, and launch readiness activities across multiple concurrent global implementations.
Lead implementation and governance meetings with internal stakeholders and client project teams, ensuring clear accountability for deliverables, timelines, and open issues.
Maintain implementation status reporting, risk and action logs, and executive updates, proactively driving resolution of or escalating issues that could impact launch.
Conduct formal implementation handoffs to ensure Recruiting and Account Management teams have the documentation, system access, client requirements, billing setup, and operational instructions needed for ongoing delivery.
Lead post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and improve future implementations.

Contracts, Compliance & Operational Readiness

Coordinate and track the execution of MSAs, SOWs, country-specific addenda, and related contractual documentation, including redlines, approvals, signatures, and implementation dependencies through completion.
Identify legal, commercial, compliance, or operational issues requiring escalation to Legal, regional experts, or other appropriate stakeholders.
Coordinate client insurance and risk documentation, including Certificates of Insurance, endorsements, additional insured requirements, and renewals, in partnership with the Consultant Care Compliance Team, insurance brokers, Legal, and Finance.
Maintain centralized, audit-ready implementation documentation and executed agreements.

Client Systems & Technology Enablement

Coordinate setup and operational readiness of client portals, VMS/MSP platforms, Bullhorn, timesheet systems, invoicing configurations, and other client-facing technologies.
Partner with Technology, Finance, Recruiting, and client system administrators to validate system access, integrations, workflows, reporting requirements, and readiness prior to launch.
Document client-specific workflows and configurations and identify opportunities to standardize, automate, or streamline implementation activities.

Client Implementation Support & Operational Excellence

Serve as a key implementation and operational contact for clients before, during, and through the post-launch transition, partnering with Sales and Account Management as owners of the broader client relationship.
Serve as a coordination point for post-implementation client needs, including existing client surveys (risk, compliance, etc.) and amendments to MSAs, SOWs, country-specific addenda, and related contractual documentation, coordinating with Account Management and functional teams and tracking redlines, approvals, and signatures through completion.
Build effective working relationships with client procurement, HR, operations, and other implementation stakeholders and support implementation-related needs throughout the client lifecycle.
Develop and maintain standardized global implementation methodologies, templates, governance processes, and playbooks.
Monitor implementation performance and identify process, automation, and technology improvements that strengthen implementation quality, reduce onboarding timelines, and support Infotree's evolving global operating model.

Global Country Expansion & Operational Readiness

Lead project planning and coordination for client expansion into new countries, partnering with the Entity Management team and functional leaders to define requirements, dependencies, owners, timelines, and launch readiness.
Partner with Legal, Finance, Human Resources, regional leadership, and external providers and advisors to support evaluation of the appropriate internal operating model for each market.
Assist functional teams in developing and executing country implementation plans, coordinating cross-functional activities and dependencies to ensure operational requirements are addressed prior to launch.
Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and open items across workstreams, escalating issues and driving accountability to keep country launches on schedule.
Assist in the development and continuous improvement of country-specific implementation playbooks and checklists to support consistent, scalable expansion into new markets.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in client implementation, onboarding, operations, project management, or client delivery within staffing, EOR/PEO, payroll, HR technology, or another multi-country services organization.
Exceptional project management skills, with demonstrated success leading multiple complex, concurrent implementations, managing dependencies and risks, and driving successful client launches.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a natural ability to create structure from complexity, manage competing priorities, and anticipate issues before they impact implementation.
Excellent communicator with executive presence and strong client-facing skills, able to build effective relationships with senior leaders, clients, and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across Sales, Legal, Finance, Technology, Recruiting, Operations, and regional teams.
Strong working knowledge of commercial contracts, vendor and procurement processes, Certificates of Insurance, and implementation governance and documentation.
Experience with VMS/MSP platforms such as Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar; Bullhorn or comparable staffing systems; CRM platforms; and other implementation technologies.
Familiarity with global staffing operations, international employment models, EOR/PEO solutions, payroll processes, and global workforce management is strongly preferred.
Experience coordinating with external partners such as payroll providers, legal counsel, insurance brokers, implementation partners, and regional service providers is preferred.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity across countries, cultures, regulatory environments, and workforce models while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Ability to travel occasionally, including internationally, for client meetings, implementation workshops, and team collaboration.

Why Join Infotree Global

This is a unique opportunity to help build and shape a global implementation function at a growing international organization. You will play a pivotal role in how Infotree launches new clients, expands into new markets, and delivers a consistent client experience across regions.
Beyond leading implementations, you will help establish the standards, governance, and scalable processes that support Infotree's continued global growth.
Join a collaborative, people-focused organization committed to innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional client service.
Competitive base salary of $100,000 - 140,000 annually, plus bonus, commensurate with experience, along with a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and other employee wellness programs. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other business considerations.
This is a fully remote, global role requiring flexibility to collaborate across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Working hours will be structured to maximize reasonable overlap with stakeholders across regions.

About Infotree Global

Infotree Global is a leading workforce solutions and technology services company that connects organizations with exceptional talent across a wide range of industries and markets worldwide. Through staffing, employer of record (EOR), managed services, and consulting solutions, Infotree helps clients navigate complex workforce challenges while delivering a high-touch experience for consultants and employees. With a strong commitment to innovation, service excellence, and people-first values, Infotree continues to expand its global footprint while maintaining a culture built on integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnerships.

Infotree is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants must be authorized to work in the country for which they are applying. Sponsorship is not currently available. new_jobs.description:
Marketing Data Analyst

Location:
Brickell, Miami, FL
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Department:
Marketing
Turn Data Into Decisions. Turn Marketing Investment Into Measurable Growth.

The Ferraro Law Firm, P.A. is seeking a highly analytical and technically skilled Senior Marketing Data Analyst / Business Intelligence Analyst
to transform complex marketing, intake, and client acquisition data into actionable business intelligence.

This is not a traditional marketing reporting role.

We are looking for someone who can build the infrastructure and analysis necessary to answer the questions that matter:
Where are our best cases coming from? Which campaigns generate qualified leads and signed clients? What does it cost to acquire a case? Where are leads being lost? Which marketing investments should we increase, decrease, or eliminate?

The ideal candidate can work across multiple data sources—including advertising platforms, web analytics, call tracking, CRM/case-management systems, and intake data—to create a reliable picture of performance from marketing spend through signed case and business outcome.

What You'll Own

Marketing & Client Acquisition Analytics
Analyze performance across paid search, paid social, SEO, organic, referral, television, digital, and other client acquisition channels.
Build reporting that connects the full acquisition funnel:

Marketing Spend → Lead → Qualified Lead → Intake → Consultation → Signed Case → Case Type/Value

Measure lead quality—not simply lead volume—across campaigns, channels, vendors, geographies, keywords, and practice areas.
Analyze cost and conversion performance by campaign and acquisition source.
Identify underperforming marketing investments and opportunities to improve ROI.
Conduct cohort, funnel, trend, and segmentation analyses to identify patterns in client acquisition.
Partner with Marketing and Intake leadership to determine why qualified leads are converting—or being lost.

Business Intelligence & Dashboard Development
Design, build, and maintain executive dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar BI platforms
.
Develop dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into marketing spend, lead generation, intake performance, signed cases, and acquisition costs.
Automate recurring reporting and reduce dependence on manual spreadsheet-based analysis.
Establish standardized KPI definitions and reporting methodologies across Marketing and Intake.
Develop reporting that allows leadership to drill down from firm-wide performance to individual campaigns, sources, markets, and practice areas.

Attribution & ROI Analysis
Develop and improve marketing attribution models across multiple channels and client touchpoints.
Connect advertising and lead-source data to CRM and case-management records.
Analyze the relationship between marketing investment and actual signed cases.
Evaluate campaign performance based on business outcomes rather than clicks, impressions, or surface-level lead volume
.
Develop methodologies for measuring customer/client acquisition cost, return on ad spend, and marketing ROI.
Identify attribution gaps and recommend improvements to tracking architecture.

Data Analysis & Infrastructure
Use SQL
to query, combine, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Integrate and reconcile information from platforms such as:
Salesforce / Litify
Google Analytics 4
Google Ads
Meta Ads
Call-tracking platforms
Intake systems
Internal databases and spreadsheets
Identify data-quality issues, duplicate records, attribution inconsistencies, and tracking gaps.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to improve data integrity.
Create repeatable processes for extracting, transforming, validating, and analyzing marketing and intake data.
Maintain documentation for reporting logic, KPI definitions, and data sources.

Core KPIs
The Senior Marketing Data Analyst will help establish, monitor, and improve metrics including:
Marketing Spend
Cost per Lead (CPL)
Cost per Qualified Lead
Cost per Consultation
Cost per Signed Case / Client Acquisition Cost
Lead-to-Qualified Conversion Rate
Qualified Lead-to-Signed-Case Conversion Rate
Overall Lead-to-Signed-Case Conversion Rate
Intake Conversion Rate
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
Marketing ROI
Lead Quality by Source
Signed Cases by Campaign
Acquisition Cost by Practice Area
Funnel Leakage / Lost Lead Analysis

What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Marketing Analytics, Computer Science
, or a related quantitative discipline.
3+ years of experience
in marketing analytics, business intelligence, performance analytics, or a comparable data-driven role.
Strong SQL skills and demonstrated ability to work with large, complex datasets.
Advanced proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or comparable BI/data visualization platforms
.
Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 and digital advertising data
.
Strong understanding of marketing attribution, conversion funnels, CAC/CPA, CPL, ROAS, and ROI.
Experience combining data from multiple systems and identifying inconsistencies between data sources.
Experience with Salesforce, Litify, or another CRM/case-management platform strongly preferred.
Familiarity with call tracking and lead attribution platforms is highly desirable.
Python or R experience is a plus.
Experience with APIs, ETL processes, data warehouses, or cloud-based analytics environments is a plus.
Experience in legal marketing, personal injury, mass torts, lead generation, healthcare, insurance, or another high-value consumer acquisition industry
is highly desirable.

This Is Not a Reporting-Only Position
We are not looking for someone whose primary function is exporting reports and distributing spreadsheets.

We need an analyst who will interrogate the data.

When CPL increases, you investigate why.
When lead volume increases but signed cases decline, you identify where the funnel is breaking.
When two platforms report different conversion numbers, you determine which data is reliable.
When a campaign generates inexpensive leads but poor-quality cases, you make that visible.
When the data identifies an opportunity, you communicate it clearly enough for leadership to act.
Your responsibility is not simply to tell us what happened.

Your responsibility is to help us understand why it happened, what it means, and what we should investigate or change next.

Performance Expectations
Success in this role will be measured by the analyst's ability to:
Produce accurate, reliable, and actionable business intelligence.
Improve visibility into the firm's true cost of client acquisition.
Establish reliable attribution from marketing source through signed case.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and conversion.
Detect weaknesses within the Marketing-to-Intake funnel.
Reduce manual reporting through dashboarding and automation.
Improve data quality and confidence in executive reporting.
Deliver insights that influence marketing investment decisions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to senior leadership.
Proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities before being asked.

Who Will Succeed Here
You are highly analytical, naturally skeptical of incomplete data, and comfortable digging until you understand what is actually happening.
You don't confuse more leads
with better marketing
.
You understand that a campaign generating 500 leads may be less valuable than one generating 50 highly qualified cases.

You are equally comfortable building a SQL query, analyzing a conversion funnel, creating an executive dashboard, and explaining your conclusions to someone who doesn't work in analytics.
You take ownership of the accuracy of your work and understand that leadership may make significant investment decisions based on the information you provide.

About The Ferraro Law Firm, P.A.
The Ferraro Law Firm, P.A. is a plaintiff-side law firm representing individuals and families in significant personal injury, catastrophic injury, and mass tort matters.
As our marketing and client acquisition operations continue to evolve, we are investing in stronger analytics and business intelligence capabilities to ensure our decisions are driven by reliable data, measurable performance, and actual business outcomes.

Full-Time

Fast-paced, analytical, collaborative, and performance-driven
If you are a data professional who wants to move beyond reporting dashboards and have a direct impact on marketing strategy, client acquisition, and business growth
, we encourage you to apply.

Are you a highly motivated, compassionate and dedicated individual looking for a rewarding career assisting the most vulnerable citizens of Texas in need of food, medical care, cash assistance and other social services?

AES provides an integrated and streamlined approach to connect individuals to services and supports that: reduce institutionalization, allow individuals to remain in their communities, and promote economic and personal self-sufficiency. About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking an Information System Security Manager in support of Peraton Labs' information assurance and information technology operations. This is a full-time on-site position working out of the Silver Spring, Maryland office.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Lead and manage information assurance efforts, and systems across numerous environments in Silver Spring, MD.
Perform Information System Security Manager (ISSM) roles and responsibilities as prescribed by the DAAG, JSIG, ICD-503, and other applicable regulations.
Create, manage, and maintain RMF Package documentation, submissions, and associated artifacts. This will include A&A packages, ASA packages, SCRs, etc.
Prepare, deliver and update all required documentation using the current approved templates, forms, regulations, and methods.
Meet continuous monitoring requirements for the accredited information systems, to include weekly auditing, performing of backups, AV updates, OS patching, vulnerability scanning, and other prescribed tasks.
Manage security vulnerabilities, implement timely remediation, monitor security logs for violations and anomalous events, and report information security concerns and problems when necessary.
Generate Plan of Actions & Milestones (POA&Ms) for each non-compliant control, manage all applicable POA&Ms throughout the information system lifecycle. Proper documentation shall be filed and updated as required.
Oversee the management and maintenance of Linux and Microsoft classified information systems, with the ability to assist in technical efforts when needed. This may include building systems, installing software, and/or troubleshooting information systems and network devices.
Apply security controls based on the DoD Security Technical Implementation Guidance and other customer requirements.
Work closely with the key stakeholders to identify any additional controls that are applicable to the system(s) to maintain a favorable security posture.
Assist in incident response, annual self-inspection, and inventory efforts.
Track the deployment of all applicable software and hardware to classified environments.
Provide, track, and report security requirements throughout the system life cycle of all information systems that are within the accreditation boundary.
Provide timely and detailed responses to user and customer requests.
Continuously maintain a thorough understanding of all relevant corporate policies, security control plans as well as system configurations, architecture, installed software, accounts (both Operating System and Application), data flows, ports, protocols, and other relevant data for each Information System.
Maintain required certifications for this role.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications/Skills:

Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD
CISSP or equivalent certification (DoD 8570 IAM Level III).
Experience with SAP and/or DCSA assessments and authorizations.
5+ years experience with Authority to Operate (ATO) process, continuous monitoring, POA&Ms, Security Authorizations (SA), NIST 800-37, NIST 800-53 Rev4/ Rev5, working with Information System Owners (ISO) and Program Managers (PM).
Experience with SCAP, STIGs, and other compliance tools.
Proven written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work well with team members.
Active TS clearance with ability to obtain SCI.

Desired Skills/Qualifications

Preferred degree in a technical discipline such as computer science, cybersecurity, or information technology.
Experience with Ongoing Authorizations
Experience with eMASS
Experience with ACAS, Nessus, and/or other vulnerability scanners
3+ years of solid Linux system administration working experience with specific focus on Ubuntu and RedHat distributions.
Experience with Linux shell scripting include writing new scripts and troubleshoot existing codes.
In-depth knowledge of TCP/IP and networking concepts and a solid understanding of the well-known services including DHCP, DNS, SSH, TLS, IPSec, etc.

Details

Target Salary Range: $112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.
